title.zh: 卷一百〇九 志第六十二 禮十二
title.raw: 卷一百〇九 志第六十二 禮十二 Volume 109 Treatises 62: Rites 12

sentences.zh: 禮十二

translations.literal: Rites XII
translations.idiomatic: Rites XII

sentences.zh: 〈（吉禮十二）〉

translations.literal: (Auspicious Rites XII)
translations.idiomatic: (Auspicious Rites XII)

sentences.zh: ○后廟景靈宮神御殿功臣配侑群臣家廟

translations.literal: ○ Empress temples; Jingling Palace; Hall of Imperial Spirit Tablets; associated offerings for meritorious ministers; family temples of officials
translations.idiomatic: ○ Empress temples; Jingling Palace; the Hall of Imperial Spirit Tablets; associated offerings for meritorious ministers; and the family temples of officials

sentences.zh: 后廟之制。

translations.literal: Regulations concerning empress temples.
translations.idiomatic: The regulations governing empress temples.

sentences.zh: 建隆三年，追冊會稽郡夫人賀氏曰孝惠皇后，止就陵所置祠殿奉安神主，薦常饌，不設牙盤祭器。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianlong, Lady He of Kuaiji Commandery was posthumously enfeoffed as Empress Xiaohui. Only a shrine hall was set up at the tomb precinct to enshrine the spirit tablet, with regular offerings presented, and tooth-disk ritual vessels were not provided.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jianlong, Lady He of Kuaiji Commandery was posthumously enfeoffed as Empress Xiaohui. A shrine hall alone was established at her tomb precinct to receive her spirit tablet, with regular offerings presented, but the tooth-disk altar vessels were not set out.

sentences.zh: 乾德元年，孝明皇后王氏崩，始議置廟及二后先後之次。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qiande, when Empress Xiaoming, Lady Wang, died, discussion began on establishing a temple and on the precedence of the two former empresses.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qiande, after Empress Xiaoming, Lady Wang, died, the court began debating whether to establish a temple and how to order the two former empresses.

sentences.zh: 太常博士和峴請共殿別室，以孝明正位內朝，請居上室；

translations.literal: Court Gentleman for Ceremonies He Yan requested a shared hall with separate chambers: with Empress Xiaoming in the principal position within the inner court, she should occupy the upper chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Court Gentleman for Ceremonies He Yan proposed a single hall with separate chambers: because Empress Xiaoming held the principal place in the inner court, her tablet should occupy the upper chamber.

sentences.zh: 孝惠緣改葬，不造虞主，與孝明同祔，宜居次室。

translations.literal: Empress Xiaohui, because of the change of burial, had no mourning tablet made; enshrined together with Empress Xiaoming, she should occupy the lower chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Xiaohui, because her burial had been moved and no mourning tablet had been made, was to be enshrined together with Empress Xiaoming and should occupy the lower chamber.

sentences.zh: 禮院又言：「后廟祀事，一準太廟，亦當立戟。」

translations.literal: The Board of Rites also stated: "For sacrifices at the empress temple, everything should follow the Grand Temple, and halberds should also be set up."
translations.idiomatic: The Board of Rites also reported: "Sacrifices at the empress temple should follow the Grand Temple in every respect, and halberds should likewise be set up there."

sentences.zh: 及太祖祔廟，有司言：「合奉一后配食。

translations.literal: When Taizu was enshrined in the ancestral temple, the relevant offices stated: "One empress should be offered in associated sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu was enshrined in the ancestral temple, the responsible offices stated: "One empress should receive associated sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 按唐睿宗追諡肅明、昭成二后，至睿宗崩，獨昭成以帝母之重升配，肅明止享於儀坤廟。

translations.literal: According to the Tang, when Emperor Ruizong posthumously enfeoffed Empresses Suiming and Zhaocheng, after Ruizong died only Zhaocheng, because of the weight of being the emperor's mother, was elevated to associated sacrifice; Suiming was worshipped only at the Yikun Temple.
translations.idiomatic: According to Tang precedent, when Emperor Ruizong posthumously enfeoffed Empresses Suiming and Zhaocheng, after Ruizong's death only Zhaocheng—by virtue of her standing as the emperor's mother—was elevated to associated sacrifice, while Suiming was worshipped only at the Yikun Temple.

sentences.zh: 近周世宗正惠、宣懿二后併先崩，正惠無位號，宣懿居正位，遂以配食。

translations.literal: In the recent Zhou, Empresses Zhenghui and Xuanyi of Shizong had both died earlier; Zhenghui had no title of rank, and Xuanyi held the principal position, so she received associated sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: More recently, under the Later Zhou, Empresses Zhenghui and Xuanyi of Shizong had both died earlier; Zhenghui had held no title of rank, while Xuanyi had held the principal position, and so she received associated sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 今請以孝明皇后配，忌日行香廢務，其孝惠皇后享於別廟。」

translations.literal: Now it is requested that Empress Xiaoming receive associated sacrifice, that on her death-day incense be offered and state business suspended, and that Empress Xiaohui be worshipped at a separate temple."
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was that Empress Xiaoming should receive associated sacrifice, that on her death-day incense be offered and state business suspended, and that Empress Xiaohui be worshipped at a separate temple.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 太平興國元年，追冊越國夫人符氏為懿德皇后，尹氏為淑德皇后，併祔後廟。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taiping Xingguo, Lady Fu of Yue was posthumously enfeoffed as Empress Yide, and Lady Yin as Empress Shude; both were enshrined in the empress temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taiping Xingguo, Lady Fu of Yue was posthumously enfeoffed as Empress Yide and Lady Yin as Empress Shude; both were enshrined in the empress temple.

sentences.zh: 至道三年，孝章皇后宋氏祔享，有司言：「孝章正位中壺，宜居上室，懿德追崇后號，宜居其次。」

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhidao, when Empress Xiaozhang, Lady Song, received enshrinement sacrifice, the relevant offices stated: "Empress Xiaozhang held the principal position in the inner palace and should occupy the upper chamber; Empress Yide, posthumously enfeoffed with an empress title, should rank next."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhidao, when Empress Xiaozhang, Lady Song, received enshrinement sacrifice, the relevant offices stated: "Empress Xiaozhang, who had held the principal place in the inner palace, should occupy the upper chamber; Empress Yide, posthumously enfeoffed with an empress title, should rank next.

sentences.zh: 詔孝章殿室居懿德下。

translations.literal: An edict placed Empress Xiaozhang's chamber below that of Empress Yide.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Empress Xiaozhang's chamber placed below Empress Yide's.

sentences.zh: 六月，禮官議：「按太平興國中追冊定諡，皆以懿德居上。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, ritual officials proposed: "According to posthumous enfeoffments and bestowal of posthumous titles in the Taiping Xingguo period, Empress Yide was always placed above.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, ritual officials proposed: "During the Taiping Xingguo period, whenever posthumous enfeoffments and titles were granted, Empress Yide was always placed above.

sentences.zh: 淳化初，宗正少卿趙安易言，別廟祭享，懿德在淑德之上，未測升降之由。

translations.literal: In the early Chunhua era, Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Zhao Anyi stated that at sacrifices in the separate temple, Empress Yide stood above Empress Shude, and the reason for raising or lowering rank was not understood.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Chunhua era, Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Zhao Anyi noted that at sacrifices in the separate temple Empress Yide stood above Empress Shude, and the grounds for raising or lowering rank were unclear.

sentences.zh: 其時敕旨依舊懿德在上。

translations.literal: At that time an imperial order directed that Empress Yide remain above, as before.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial order then directed that Empress Yide remain above, as before.

sentences.zh: 按《江都集禮》，晉景帝即位，夏侯夫人應合追尊。

translations.literal: According to the 《Jiangdu Collected Rites》, when Emperor Jing of Jin acceded, Lady Xia of the Xia clan should have received posthumous enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: According to the 《Jiangdu Collected Rites》, when Emperor Jing of Jin acceded, Lady Xia of the Xia clan ought to have received posthumous enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 散騎常侍任茂、傅玄等議云：『夏侯夫人初歸景帝，未有王基之道，不及景帝統百揆而亡，后妃之化未著遠邇，追尊無經義可據。』

translations.literal: Regular Attendant Ren Mao, Fu Xuan, and others debated: "When Lady Xia first married Emperor Jing, the way to royal foundation had not yet appeared; before Emperor Jing assumed command over all affairs of state she died, and the transforming influence of an empress consort had not been displayed far and near—posthumous enfeoffment has no canonical basis."
translations.idiomatic: Regular Attendant Ren Mao, Fu Xuan, and others argued: "When Lady Xia first married Emperor Jing, the path to kingship had not yet emerged; she died before he assumed command over all affairs of state, and the transforming influence of an empress consort had not been shown far and near—posthumous enfeoffment lacks canonical warrant."

sentences.zh: 今之所議，正與此同。

translations.literal: The present discussion is exactly the same as this.
translations.idiomatic: The present discussion matches this case exactly.

sentences.zh: 且淑德配合之初，潛躍之符未兆；

translations.literal: Moreover, at the beginning of Empress Shude's marriage, the omens of hidden ascent had not yet appeared;
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, at the beginning of Empress Shude's marriage, the omens of hidden ascent had not yet appeared;

sentences.zh: 懿德輔佐之始，藩邸之位已隆，然未嘗正位中宮，母臨天下。

translations.literal: at the beginning of Empress Yide's assistance, the position in the prince's household was already exalted, yet she had never held the principal position in the inner palace or presided over the realm as mother.
translations.idiomatic: at the beginning of Empress Yide's assistance, her standing in the prince's household was already lofty, yet she had never held the principal place in the inner palace or presided over the realm as mother.

sentences.zh: 豈可生無尊極之位，沒升配享之崇？

translations.literal: How can one who in life had no position of supreme honor, after death ascend to the lofty status of associated sacrifice?
translations.idiomatic: How could one who in life held no position of supreme honor, after death ascend to the lofty status of associated sacrifice?

sentences.zh: 於人情不安，於典籍無據。

translations.literal: In human sentiment this is unsettling; in canonical texts there is no warrant.
translations.idiomatic: In human sentiment this is unsettling; in canonical texts there is no warrant.

sentences.zh: 唐順宗祔廟後十一年，始以莊憲皇后升配，憲宗祔廟後二十五年，始以懿安皇后升配。

translations.literal: Eleven years after Emperor Shunzong was enshrined, only then was Empress Zhuangxian elevated to associated sacrifice; twenty-five years after Emperor Xianzong was enshrined, only then was Empress Yi'an elevated to associated sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven years after Emperor Shunzong was enshrined, Empress Zhuangxian was elevated to associated sacrifice; twenty-five years after Emperor Xianzong was enshrined, Empress Yi'an was elevated to associated sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 今請虛位，允協舊儀。」

translations.literal: Now it is requested that the place be left vacant, which accords with former ritual."
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was to leave the place vacant, which would accord with former ritual."

sentences.zh: 再詔尚書省集議及禮官同詳定。

translations.literal: Again an edict ordered the Secretariat to convene for discussion together with ritual officials for detailed determination.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again ordered the Secretariat to convene for joint discussion with ritual officials for a detailed determination.

sentences.zh: 上議曰：「淑德皇后生無位號，沒始追崇，況在初潛，早已薨謝，懿德皇后享封大國，作配先朝，雖不及臨御之期，且夙彰賢懿之美，若以升祔，當歸懿德。

translations.literal: The superior discussion stated: "Empress Shude in life had no title of rank; only after death was she posthumously enfeoffed. Moreover, in the early hidden period she had long since died. Empress Yide enjoyed enfeoffment of a great state and was consort to the former dynasty; although she did not reach the period of presiding over the court, she had long displayed worthy and virtuous excellence. If enshrinement is to be carried out, it should return to Empress Yide.
translations.idiomatic: The senior deliberation stated: "Empress Shude in life held no title of rank and received posthumous enfeoffment only after death; moreover, in the early hidden period she had long since died. Empress Yide enjoyed enfeoffment of a great state and was consort to the former dynasty; although she never reached the period of presiding over the court, she had long displayed worthy and virtuous excellence. If enshrinement is to proceed, precedence should return to Empress Yide.

sentences.zh: 又詳周世宗正惠、宣懿配食故事，當時議以正惠追尊位號，請以宣懿為配。

translations.literal: Further examining the precedent of associated sacrifice for Empresses Zhenghui and Xuanyi of Zhou Shizong, at that time the discussion, because Zhenghui received posthumous enfeoffment with a title of rank, requested that Xuanyi serve as the associated offering.
translations.idiomatic: Further examining the precedent of associated sacrifice for Empresses Zhenghui and Xuanyi of Zhou Shizong, the discussion at that time, because Zhenghui had received posthumous enfeoffment with a title of rank, requested that Xuanyi serve as the associated offering.

sentences.zh: 是時以太后在位，疑宣懿祔廟之後，立忌非便。

translations.literal: At that time, because the empress dowager was still in position, it was doubted that after Xuanyi was enshrined in the temple, establishing a death-day observance would be inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, because the empress dowager was still in position, officials doubted that after Xuanyi was enshrined in the temple, establishing a death-day observance would be inconvenient.

sentences.zh: 議者引晉哀帝時何太后在上，尊所生周氏為太妃，封其子為琅邪王。

translations.literal: The debaters cited the time of Emperor Ai of Jin, when Empress Dowager He was still alive and honored her birth mother, Lady Zhou, as Grand Consort, enfeoffing her son as Prince of Langye.
translations.idiomatic: The debaters cited the time of Emperor Ai of Jin, when Empress Dowager He was still alive and he honored his birth mother, Lady Zhou, as Grand Consort, enfeoffing her son as Prince of Langye.

sentences.zh: 及太妃薨，帝奔喪琅邪第，七月而葬。

translations.literal: When the Grand Consort died, the emperor went to mourn at the Langye residence; burial took place after seven months.
translations.idiomatic: When the Grand Consort died, the emperor went to mourn at the Langye residence, and burial took place after seven months.

sentences.zh: 此則奔喪行服，尚不厭降，即忌日廢務，於理無嫌。

translations.literal: In this case, even for rushing to mourning and wearing mourning garments, lowering of rank was still not considered excessive; therefore suspending business on the death-day is unobjectionable in principle.
translations.idiomatic: Even for rushing to mourning and wearing mourning garments, lowering of rank was still not considered excessive; therefore suspending business on the death-day is unobjectionable in principle.

sentences.zh: 今禮官引唐順、憲二宗廟，享虛位之文，夫即追冊二後，即虛室亦為非便，請奉懿德神主升配。

translations.literal: Now ritual officials cite the Tang temples of Shunzong and Xianzong and the text on enjoying an empty place. Since the two empresses have already received posthumous enfeoffment, leaving the chamber vacant is also inconvenient; it is requested that Empress Yide's spirit tablet be elevated to associated sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Now ritual officials cite the Tang temples of Shunzong and Xianzong and the passage on enjoying an empty place. Since the two empresses have already received posthumous enfeoffment, leaving the chamber vacant is also inconvenient; they requested that Empress Yide's spirit tablet be elevated to associated sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 又按議者以周世宗神主祔廟，必若宣懿同祔，即正惠神主請加『太』字。

translations.literal: Further, according to the debaters, when Shizong's spirit tablet was enshrined in the temple, if Xuanyi were enshrined together, then the character "Grand" should be added to Zhenghui's spirit tablet.
translations.idiomatic: Further, according to the debaters, when Shizong's spirit tablet was enshrined in the temple, if Xuanyi were enshrined together, the character "Grand" should be added to Zhenghui's spirit tablet.

sentences.zh: 今升祔懿德，請即加淑德『太』字，仍舊別廟。」

translations.literal: Now, with Empress Yide elevated to enshrinement, it is requested that the character "Grand" be added to Empress Shude, while she still receives worship at the separate temple."
translations.idiomatic: With Empress Yide now elevated to enshrinement, they requested that the character "Grand" be added to Empress Shude while she continued to receive worship at the separate temple."

sentences.zh: 詔：「以懿德配享，至於『太』者尊極之稱，加於母后，施之宗廟禮所未安。」

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Let Empress Yide receive associated sacrifice. As for "Grand," a title of supreme honor—adding it to an empress mother and applying it in the ancestral temple is not secure in ritual."
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Let Empress Yide receive associated sacrifice. As for "Grand," a title of supreme honor—adding it to an empress mother and applying it in the ancestral temple is not secure in ritual."

sentences.zh: 乃不加「太」字，仍別廟配享。

translations.literal: Thus the character "Grand" was not added, and she still received associated sacrifice at the separate temple.
translations.idiomatic: The character "Grand" was therefore not added, and she still received associated sacrifice at the separate temple.

sentences.zh: 十二月，追尊賢妃李氏為元德皇太后。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Worthy Consort Lady Li was posthumously honored as Grand Empress Dowager Yuande.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Worthy Consort Lady Li was posthumously honored as Grand Empress Dowager Yuande.

sentences.zh: 有司言：「按《周禮·春官》大司樂之職，『奏《夷則》，歌《仲呂》，以享先妣』，謂姜原也。

translations.literal: The relevant offices stated: "According to the office of the Grand Music Master in the 《Rites of Zhou · Director of Spring》, 'Perform the 《Yize》 mode and sing the 《Zhonglü》, to worship the former mother,' referring to Jiang Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices stated: "According to the office of the Grand Music Master in the 《Rites of Zhou · Director of Spring》, 'Perform the 《Yize》 mode and sing the 《Zhonglü》, to worship the former mother,' referring to Jiang Yuan.

sentences.zh: 是帝嚳之妃，后稷之母，特立廟曰宮。

translations.literal: She was consort of Emperor Ku, mother of Houji, and a separate temple called Gong was established.
translations.idiomatic: She was consort of Emperor Ku and mother of Houji; a separate temple called Gong was established for her.

sentences.zh: 晉簡文宣後以不配食，築室於外，歲時享祭。

translations.literal: Empress Xuan of Jin Wen, because she did not receive associated sacrifice, had a chamber built outside and received seasonal sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Xuan of Jin Wen, because she did not receive associated sacrifice, had a chamber built outside the main temple and received seasonal sacrifices there.

sentences.zh: 唐先天元年，始祔昭成、肅明二后於儀坤廟。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xiantian of Tang, Empresses Zhaocheng and Suiming were first enshrined in the Yikun Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xiantian of Tang, Empresses Zhaocheng and Suiming were first enshrined in the Yikun Temple.

sentences.zh: 又玄宗元獻楊后立廟於太廟之西。

translations.literal: Further, Empress Yang Yuansian of Tang Xuanzong had a temple established west of the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Further, Empress Yang Yuansian of Tang Xuanzong had a temple established west of the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 稽於前文，咸有明據。

translations.literal: Examining former texts, all have clear warrant.
translations.idiomatic: Examination of former texts shows clear warrant in each case.

sentences.zh: 望令宗正寺於后廟內修奉廟室，為殿三間，設神門、齋房、神廚，以備薦享。」

translations.literal: It is hoped that the Imperial Clan Court may within the empress temple maintain a shrine chamber—three bays for the hall, with spirit gate, fasting chamber, and spirit kitchen provided—to prepare for offering sacrifice."
translations.idiomatic: They requested that the Imperial Clan Court establish within the empress temple a shrine chamber—a three-bay hall, with spirit gate, fasting chamber, and spirit kitchen—to prepare for offering sacrifice."

sentences.zh: 咸平元年，判太常禮院李宗訥等言：「元德皇太后別建廟室，淑德皇后亦在別廟，同是帝母而無『太』字。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianping, Li Zongxun and others of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "Grand Empress Dowager Yuande has a separately built shrine chamber; Empress Shude is also in a separate temple—both are imperial mothers yet neither bears the character "Grand.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianping, Li Zongxun and others of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "Grand Empress Dowager Yuande has a separately built shrine chamber; Empress Shude is also in a separate temple—both are imperial mothers, yet neither bears the character "Grand.

sentences.zh: 按唐穆宗三后，除宣懿升祔，正獻、恭僖二后並立別廟，各有『太』字。

translations.literal: According to the three empresses of Tang Muzong, except for Xuanyi, who was elevated to enshrinement, Empresses Zhengxian and Gongxi both had separate temples established, each bearing the character "Grand."
translations.idiomatic: According to the three empresses of Tang Muzong, except for Xuanyi, who was elevated to enshrinement, Empresses Zhengxian and Gongxi both had separate temples established, each bearing the character "Grand."

sentences.zh: 又開元初，太常議昭成皇太后，請不除『太』字，云『入廟稱後，義係於夫，在朝稱太后，義係於子。

translations.literal: Further, in the early Kaiyuan period the Court of Imperial Sacrifices debated Empress Dowager Zhaocheng and requested not removing the character "Grand," stating: "Entering the temple one is called empress, the relationship being to the husband; at court one is called empress dowager, the relationship being to the son.
translations.idiomatic: Further, in the early Kaiyuan period the Court of Imperial Sacrifices debated Empress Dowager Zhaocheng and requested not removing the character "Grand," stating: "Entering the temple one is called empress, the relationship being to the husband; at court one is called empress dowager, the relationship being to the son.

sentences.zh: 如諡冊入陵，神主入廟，則當去太字』。

translations.literal: If the posthumous patent enters the tomb and the spirit tablet enters the temple, then the character "Grand" should be removed."
translations.idiomatic: If the posthumous patent enters the tomb and the spirit tablet enters the temple, then the character "Grand" should be removed."

sentences.zh: 按神主入廟之說，蓋為祔享太廟，以厭降故，不加『太』字，則本朝文懿諸後是也。

translations.literal: According to the theory of the spirit tablet entering the temple, this is for enshrinement in the Grand Temple; because of lowering of rank, the character "Grand" is not added—such are the empresses Wanyi and others of this dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: According to the theory of the spirit tablet entering the temple, this applies when enshrining in the Grand Temple; because of lowering of rank, the character "Grand" is not added—such are Empresses Wanyi and others of this dynasty.

sentences.zh: 如別建廟室，不可但稱皇后，則唐正獻、恭僖二太后是也。

translations.literal: If a separate shrine chamber is built, one cannot simply be called empress—such are the Grand Empresses Dowager Zhengxian and Gongxi of Tang.
translations.idiomatic: If a separate shrine chamber is built, one cannot simply be called empress—such are Grand Empresses Dowager Zhengxian and Gongxi of Tang.

sentences.zh: 淑德皇后亦請加『太』字，既加之後，望遷就元德新廟，居第一室，以元德次之，仍遷莊懷又次之。」

translations.literal: It is also requested that the character "Grand" be added to Empress Shude; after it is added, it is hoped she may be moved to the new temple of Yuande, occupying the first chamber, with Yuande second and Zhuanghuai moved to third."
translations.idiomatic: They also requested that the character "Grand" be added to Empress Shude; after it was added, she should be moved to the new temple of Yuande, occupying the first chamber, with Yuande second and Zhuanghuai moved to third."

sentences.zh: 詔下中書集議。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Secretariat to convene for discussion.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Secretariat to convene for discussion.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書張齊賢等奏：「宗廟神靈，務乎安靜。

translations.literal: Minister of War Zhang Qixian and others memorialized: "The spirits of the ancestral temple require tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Zhang Qixian and others memorialized: "The spirits of the ancestral temple require tranquility.

sentences.zh: 況懿德作合之始，逮事舅姑，躬執婦道，祔享之禮，宜從後先，伏請仍舊。

translations.literal: Moreover, from the beginning of Empress Yide's union, she waited on her parents-in-law and personally performed the wife's way; the rite of enshrinement should follow precedence— we respectfully request that things remain as before.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, from the beginning of Empress Yide's union she waited on her parents-in-law and personally performed the wife's way; the rite of enshrinement should follow precedence—we respectfully request that things remain as before.

sentences.zh: 又漢因秦製，帝母稱皇太后。

translations.literal: Further, following Han practice on Qin institutions, an emperor's mother is called empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: Further, following Han practice on Qin institutions, an emperor's mother is called empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 檢詳去歲議狀，請加淑德『太』字，而詔不加之者，緣當時元德皇太后未行追冊。

translations.literal: Examining last year's discussion record, the request to add the character "Grand" to Empress Shude was not approved in the edict because at that time Grand Empress Dowager Yuande had not yet received posthumous enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Examining last year's discussion record, the request to add the character "Grand" to Empress Shude was not approved in the edict because at that time Grand Empress Dowager Yuande had not yet received posthumous enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 今冊命已畢，望依禮官所言。」

translations.literal: Now that the patent of enfeoffment is complete, it is hoped that the ritual officials' statement may be followed."
translations.idiomatic: Now that the patent of enfeoffment is complete, they hoped the ritual officials' statement might be followed."

sentences.zh: 三年四月乙卯，祔葬元德皇太后於永熙陵。

translations.literal: In the third year, on the day yimao of the fourth month, Grand Empress Dowager Yuande was buried with enshrinement at Yongxi Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the day yimao of the fourth month, Grand Empress Dowager Yuande was buried with enshrinement at Yongxi Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 有司言：「元德神主祔廟，準禮當行祔謁，載稽前典，有未合者。

translations.literal: The relevant offices stated: "When the spirit tablet of Yuande is enshrined in the temple, according to ritual the enshrinement audience should be performed; examining former canons, there are points that do not accord.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices stated: "When the spirit tablet of Yuande is enshrined in the temple, according to ritual the enshrinement audience should be performed; examining former canons, there are points that do not accord.

sentences.zh: 伏以追薦尊稱，奉加『太』字，崇建別廟，以備蒸嘗。

translations.literal: Respectfully, posthumous recommendation and honorific title, with the character "Grand" added, and a separate temple magnificently built to prepare for seasonal steaming and tasting sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous recommendation and an honorific title, with the character "Grand" added, and a separate temple magnificently built to prepare for seasonal steaming and tasting sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 況當禘祫之時，不預合食之列，廟享之制與諸後不同。

translations.literal: Moreover, at the time of di and cha sacrifices, she is not in the roster of combined sacrifice; the temple worship regulations differ from those for other empresses.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, at the time of di and cha sacrifices she is not in the roster of combined sacrifice; the temple worship regulations differ from those for other empresses.

sentences.zh: 俟神主還京，即祔廟室，薦獻安神，更不行祔謁之禮，每歲五享、禘祫如太廟儀。」

translations.literal: When the spirit tablet returns to the capital, it will be enshrined in the temple chamber, offerings presented and the spirit settled, and the enshrinement audience will not again be performed; each year the five seasonal sacrifices and di and cha will follow Grand Temple ritual."
translations.idiomatic: When the spirit tablet returns to the capital it will be enshrined in the temple chamber, offerings presented and the spirit settled, and the enshrinement audience will not again be performed; each year the five seasonal sacrifices and di and cha will follow Grand Temple ritual."

sentences.zh: 景德四年，奉莊穆皇后郭氏神主謁太廟，祔享於昭憲皇后。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jingde, the spirit tablet of Empress Zhuangmu, Lady Guo, was presented at the Grand Temple and received enshrinement sacrifice with Empress Zhaoxian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jingde, the spirit tablet of Empress Zhuangmu, Lady Guo, was presented at the Grand Temple and received enshrinement sacrifice with Empress Zhaoxian.

sentences.zh: 享畢，祔別廟，殿室在莊懷之上。

translations.literal: When the sacrifice was complete, she was enshrined in the separate temple, her hall chamber above Zhuanghuai.
translations.idiomatic: When the sacrifice was complete, she was enshrined in the separate temple, her hall chamber placed above Zhuanghuai.

sentences.zh: 帝祀汾陰，謁廟畢，親詣元德皇太后廟躬謝，自門降輦步入，酌獻如太廟，設登歌，兩省、御史、宗室防禦使以上班廟內，餘班廟外，遣官分告孝惠諸後廟。

translations.literal: When the emperor performed the Feng and Shan sacrifices at Fen, after completing the temple audience he personally went to the temple of Grand Empress Dowager Yuande to offer thanks in person; he descended from the carriage at the gate and entered on foot, performed libation and offering as at the Grand Temple, set ascending song, and officials of the two departments, the censorate, and imperial clansmen of Defender-in-Chief rank and above were arrayed inside the temple, the remainder outside; officials were dispatched to announce separately at the temples of Empress Xiaohui and the other empresses.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor performed the Feng and Shan sacrifices at Fen, after completing the temple audience he personally went to the temple of Grand Empress Dowager Yuande to offer thanks in person; he descended from the carriage at the gate and entered on foot, performed libation and offering as at the Grand Temple, set ascending song, and officials of the two departments, the censorate, and imperial clansmen of Defender-in-Chief rank and above were arrayed inside the temple, the remainder outside; officials were dispatched to announce separately at the temples of Empress Xiaohui and the other empresses.

sentences.zh: 詔：「太廟、元德皇后廟享用犢，諸後廟親享用犢，攝事用羊、豕。」

translations.literal: An edict stated: "The Grand Temple and the temple of Grand Empress Dowager Yuande use yearling oxen for sacrifice; the temples of the other empresses use yearling oxen when the emperor sacrifices in person, and sheep and pig when another officiates."
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "The Grand Temple and the temple of Grand Empress Dowager Yuande use yearling oxen for sacrifice; the temples of the other empresses use yearling oxen when the emperor sacrifices in person, and sheep and pig when another officiates."

sentences.zh: 五年，龍圖閣直學士陳彭年言：「禘祫日，孝惠、淑德二後神主自別廟赴太廟，祔簡穆皇后神主之下、太祖神主之上，此蓋用《曲台禮》別廟皇后禘祫祔享太廟之說。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Academician Expositor Chen Pengnian stated: "On the day of di and cha, the spirit tablets of Empresses Xiaohui and Shude proceed from the separate temple to the Grand Temple and are enshrined below the spirit tablet of Empress Jianmu and above the spirit tablet of Taizu—this apparently follows the 《Quetai Rites》 account of empresses of separate temples receiving di and cha enshrinement sacrifice at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Academician Expositor Chen Pengnian stated: "On the day of di and cha, the spirit tablets of Empresses Xiaohui and Shude proceed from the separate temple to the Grand Temple and are enshrined below the spirit tablet of Empress Jianmu and above the spirit tablet of Taizu—this apparently follows the 《Quetai Rites》 account of empresses of separate temples receiving di and cha enshrinement sacrifice at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 竊慮明靈合享，神禮未安，望詔禮官再加詳定。」

translations.literal: I fear that for the bright spirits to receive combined sacrifice the spirit ritual is not secure; it is hoped that ritual officials may again deliberate in detail."
translations.idiomatic: I fear that for the bright spirits to receive combined sacrifice the spirit ritual is not secure; it is hoped that ritual officials may deliberate again in detail."

sentences.zh: 有司言：「按《曲台禮》載禘祫之儀，則如皇后先祔別廟，遇禘祫祔享於太廟，如是昭後，即坐於祖姑之下，南向；

translations.literal: The relevant offices stated: "According to the 《Quetai Rites》 account of di and cha ritual, if an empress is first enshrined in a separate temple, when di and cha occur she receives enshrinement sacrifice at the Grand Temple; if she is a zhao empress, she is seated below the paternal grandmother-in-law, facing south;
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices stated: "According to the 《Quetai Rites》 account of di and cha ritual, if an empress is first enshrined in a separate temple, when di and cha occur she receives enshrinement sacrifice at the Grand Temple; if she is a zhao empress, she is seated below the paternal grandmother-in-law, facing south;

sentences.zh: 如是穆後，即坐於祖姑之下，北向。

translations.literal: if she is a mu empress, she is seated below the paternal grandmother-in-law, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: if she is a mu empress, she is seated below the paternal grandmother-in-law, facing north.

sentences.zh: 又按博士殷盈孫議云：『別廟皇后禘袷於太廟，祔於祖姑之下者，此乃皇后先沒，已造神主。

translations.literal: Further, according to the discussion of Academician Yin Yingsun: "Empresses of separate temples at di and cha in the Grand Temple, enshrined below the paternal grandmother-in-law—this is when the empress died first and the spirit tablet was already made.
translations.idiomatic: Further, according to the discussion of Academician Yin Yingsun: "Empresses of separate temples at di and cha in the Grand Temple, enshrined below the paternal grandmother-in-law—this is when the empress died first and the spirit tablet was already made.

sentences.zh: 如昭成、肅明之沒也，睿宗在位；

translations.literal: When Zhaocheng and Suiming died, Ruizong was on the throne;
translations.idiomatic: When Zhaocheng and Suiming died, Ruizong was on the throne;

sentences.zh: 元獻之沒也，玄宗在位；

translations.literal: when Yuansian died, Xuanzong was on the throne;
translations.idiomatic: when Yuansian died, Xuanzong was on the throne;

sentences.zh: 昭德之沒也，德宗在位。

translations.literal: when Zhaode died, Dezong was on the throne.
translations.idiomatic: when Zhaode died, Dezong was on the throne.

sentences.zh: 四後於太廟未有本室，故創別廟，當為太廟合食之主，故禘袷乃奉以入享，此明其後太廟有本室，即當遷祔。

translations.literal: The four empresses had no original chamber in the Grand Temple, so separate temples were created; they should serve as principals for combined sacrifice in the Grand Temple, and therefore at di and cha they are brought in for sacrifice—this shows that afterward, when the Grand Temple has an original chamber, they should be moved to enshrinement.
translations.idiomatic: The four empresses had no original chamber in the Grand Temple, so separate temples were created; they should serve as principals for combined sacrifice in the Grand Temple, and therefore at di and cha they are brought in for sacrifice—this shows that afterward, when the Grand Temple has an original chamber, they should be moved to enshrinement.

sentences.zh: 帝方在位，故皇后暫立別廟，禮本合食，故禘祫乃升太廟，以未有位，故祔祖姑之下。

translations.literal: The emperor was still on the throne, so the empress was temporarily established in a separate temple; the ritual fundamentally calls for combined sacrifice, so at di and cha she ascends to the Grand Temple; because she had no position yet, she is enshrined below the paternal grandmother-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was still on the throne, so the empress was temporarily established in a separate temple; the ritual fundamentally calls for combined sacrifice, so at di and cha she ascends to the Grand Temple; because she had no position yet, she is enshrined below the paternal grandmother-in-law.

sentences.zh: 據《開寶通禮》與《曲台禮》同。

translations.literal: According to the 《Kaibao Comprehensive Rites》, it is the same as the 《Quetai Rites》.
translations.idiomatic: According to the 《Kaibao Comprehensive Rites》, it is the same as the 《Quetai Rites》.

sentences.zh: 今有司不達禮意，遇禘祫歲，尚以孝惠、孝章、淑德三後神主祔享祖姑之下，乃在太祖、太宗之上。

translations.literal: Now the relevant offices do not comprehend the ritual intent; encountering the year of di and cha, they still have the spirit tablets of Empresses Xiaohui, Xiaozhang, and Shude receive enshrinement sacrifice below the paternal grandmother-in-law—yet they are above Taizu and Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: Now the relevant offices do not comprehend the ritual intent; in years of di and cha they still have the spirit tablets of Empresses Xiaohui, Xiaozhang, and Shude receive enshrinement sacrifice below the paternal grandmother-in-law—yet placed above Taizu and Taizong.

sentences.zh: 按《禮》稱『婦祔祖姑』，謂既卒哭之明日，此正禮也；

translations.literal: According to the 《Rites》, it says "the wife is enshrined with the paternal grandmother-in-law," meaning on the day after the end of wailing—this is the correct ritual;
translations.idiomatic: According to the 《Rites》, it says "the wife is enshrined with the paternal grandmother-in-law," meaning on the day after the end of wailing—this is the correct ritual;

sentences.zh: 稱『祖姑有三人，則祔於親者』，注，玄謂『舅之母死，而又有繼室二人，親者謂舅所生』。

translations.literal: it says "if there are three paternal grandmothers-in-law, enshrine with the intimate one"—the commentary by Zheng Xuan states "when the uncle's mother dies and there are two successive chambers, the intimate one means the one born to the uncle."
translations.idiomatic: it says "if there are three paternal grandmothers-in-law, enshrine with the intimate one"—Zheng Xuan's commentary states "when the uncle's mother dies and there are two successive chambers, the intimate one means the one born to the uncle."

sentences.zh: 然則祖姑有三人同在祖室，明婦有數人亦當同在夫之本室，不可久祔於祖姑也。

translations.literal: Thus, if three paternal grandmothers-in-law are together in the ancestral chamber, clearly when there are several wives they should also be together in the husband's original chamber—they cannot long remain enshrined with the paternal grandmother-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: Thus, if three paternal grandmothers-in-law are together in the ancestral chamber, clearly when there are several wives they should also be together in the husband's original chamber—they cannot long remain enshrined with the paternal grandmother-in-law.

sentences.zh: 故《開元禮》但載肅明皇后別廟時享之儀，而無禘袷之禮，即知別廟時享及禘祫皆於本廟也。

translations.literal: Therefore the 《Kaiyuan Rites》 records only the seasonal sacrifice ritual when Empress Suiming had a separate temple, and has no di and cha ritual—thus one knows that seasonal sacrifice at the separate temple and di and cha are both at the original temple.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the 《Kaiyuan Rites》 records only the seasonal sacrifice ritual when Empress Suiming had a separate temple, and has no di and cha ritual—thus one knows that seasonal sacrifice at the separate temple and di and cha are both conducted at the original temple.

sentences.zh: 孝惠、孝章、淑德禘祫既祔太廟，則自今禘祫祔享本室，次於正主，庶協典禮。」

translations.literal: For Empresses Xiaohui, Xiaozhang, and Shude, since di and cha have already been enshrined in the Grand Temple, from now on at di and cha let enshrinement sacrifice be in the original chamber, next after the principal tablet, which will accord with canonical ritual."
translations.idiomatic: For Empresses Xiaohui, Xiaozhang, and Shude, since di and cha have already been enshrined in the Grand Temple, from now on at di and cha let enshrinement sacrifice be in the original chamber, next after the principal tablet, which will accord with canonical ritual."

sentences.zh: 六年，升祔元德皇后太宗廟室，詔以祔廟歲時為合享次序，而位明德皇后之次。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Empress Yuande was elevated to enshrinement in Taizong's temple chamber; an edict made the year of enshrinement the order for combined sacrifice, with her place next after Empress Mingde.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Empress Yuande was elevated to enshrinement in Taizong's temple chamber; an edict made the year of enshrinement the order for combined sacrifice, with her place next after Empress Mingde.

sentences.zh: 明道二年，判河南府錢惟演請以章獻、章懿二後並祔真宗之室。

translations.literal: In the second year of Mingdao, Qian Weiyan, acting as Director-General of Henan, requested that Empresses Zhangxian and Zhangyi both be enshrined in Zhenzong's chamber.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Mingdao, Qian Weiyan, acting as Director-General of Henan, requested that Empresses Zhangxian and Zhangyi both be enshrined in Zhenzong's chamber.

sentences.zh: 太常禮院議：「夏、商以來，父昭子穆，皆有配坐，每室一帝一後，禮之正儀。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices deliberated: "From Xia and Shang onward, father zhao and son mu all have associated seating; each chamber has one emperor and one empress—this is the correct ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices deliberated: "From Xia and Shang onward, father zhao and son mu all have associated seating; each chamber has one emperor and one empress—this is the correct ritual.

sentences.zh: 唐開元中，昭成、肅明二後始並祔於睿宗。

translations.literal: In the Kaiyuan period of Tang, Empresses Zhaocheng and Suiming were first enshrined together in Ruizong's temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kaiyuan period of Tang, Empresses Zhaocheng and Suiming were first enshrined together in Ruizong's temple.

sentences.zh: 今惟演引唐武宗母韋太后升祔穆宗，本朝孝明、孝章禘太祖故事。

translations.literal: Now Weiyan cites the Tang elevation of Empress Dowager Wei, mother of Wuzong, to enshrinement with Muzong, and the stories of this dynasty's Empresses Xiaoming and Xiaozhang at di with Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: Now Weiyan cites the Tang elevation of Empress Dowager Wei, mother of Wuzong, to enshrinement with Muzong, and the stories of this dynasty's Empresses Xiaoming and Xiaozhang at di with Taizu.

sentences.zh: 按穆宗惟韋后祔，太祖未嘗以孝章配。

translations.literal: According to Muzong, only Empress Wei was enshrined; Taizu never had Empress Xiaozhang as associated offering.
translations.idiomatic: According to Muzong, only Empress Wei was enshrined; Taizu never had Empress Xiaozhang as associated offering.

sentences.zh: 伏尋先帝以懿德配享太宗，及明德園陵禮畢，遂得升祔。

translations.literal: Examining the former emperor, Empress Yide received associated sacrifice with Taizong; after the park tomb rites for Empress Mingde were complete, she was then able to ascend to enshrinement.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the former emperor, Empress Yide received associated sacrifice with Taizong; after the park tomb rites for Empress Mingde were complete, she was then able to ascend to enshrinement.

sentences.zh: 元德太后自追尊後，凡十七年始克升祔。

translations.literal: Grand Empress Dowager Yuande, after posthumous honor, required seventeen years before she could ascend to enshrinement.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Empress Dowager Yuande, after posthumous honor, required seventeen years before she could ascend to enshrinement.

sentences.zh: 今章穆皇后著位長秋，祔食真宗，斯為正禮。

translations.literal: Now Empress Zhangmu held position in Changqiu; associated sacrifice with Zhenzong is the correct ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Now Empress Zhangmu had held position in Changqiu; associated sacrifice with Zhenzong is the correct ritual.

sentences.zh: 章獻太后母儀天下，與明德例同，若從古禮，止應祀後廟，若便升祔，似非先帝慎重之意，又況前代無同日並祔之比，惟上裁之。」

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Zhangxian was mother to the realm, the same as Empress Mingde in precedent; if following ancient ritual, she should be worshipped only at the empress temple; if enshrinement is carried out at once, it seems not to be the former emperor's intent of caution. Moreover, in former ages there is no precedent for enshrinement on the same day; let the emperor decide."
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Zhangxian was mother to the realm, the same as Empress Mingde in precedent; if following ancient ritual, she should be worshipped only at the empress temple; if enshrinement is carried out at once, it seems not to reflect the former emperor's intent of caution. Moreover, in former ages there is no precedent for enshrinement on the same day; let the emperor decide."

sentences.zh: 乃詔有司更議，皆謂：「章穆位崇中壺，與懿德有異，已祔廟室，自協一帝一後之文。

translations.literal: Then an edict ordered the relevant offices to deliberate again; all stated: "Empress Zhangmu's position was exalted in the inner palace and differs from Empress Yide; having been enshrined in the temple chamber, she naturally accords with the text of one emperor and one empress.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered the relevant offices to deliberate again; all stated: "Empress Zhangmu's position was exalted in the inner palace and differs from Empress Yide; having been enshrined in the temple chamber, she naturally accords with the rule of one emperor and one empress.

sentences.zh: 章獻輔政十年，章懿誕育帝躬，功德莫與為比，退就後廟，未厭眾心。

translations.literal: Empress Zhangxian assisted in government for ten years; Empress Zhangyi gave birth to the emperor's person—their merit and virtue have no equal. To withdraw to the empress temple does not satisfy the hearts of the multitude.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Zhangxian had assisted in government for ten years, and Empress Zhangyi had borne the emperor himself—their merit and virtue were unequaled. To have her withdraw to the empress temple alone would not satisfy public sentiment.

sentences.zh: 按《周官》大司樂職，『奏《夷則》，歌《小呂》，以享先妣』者，薑原也，帝嚳之妃，後稷之母，特立廟曰宮。

translations.literal: According to the office of the Grand Music Master in the 《Offices of Zhou》, "Perform the 《Yize》 mode and sing the 《Xiaolü》, to worship the former mother"—this is Jiang Yuan, consort of Emperor Ku and mother of Houji; a separate temple called Gong was established.
translations.idiomatic: According to the office of the Grand Music Master in the 《Offices of Zhou》, "Perform the 《Yize》 mode and sing the 《Xiaolü》, to worship the former mother"—this refers to Jiang Yuan, consort of Emperor Ku and mother of Houji, for whom a separate temple called Gong was established.

sentences.zh: 宜別立新廟，奉安二太后神主，同殿異室，歲時薦享用太廟儀。

translations.literal: It is fitting to establish a new separate temple, enshrine the spirit tablets of the two empresses dowager, share a hall with separate chambers, and at the seasons present offerings following Grand Temple ritual.
translations.idiomatic: They proposed establishing a new separate temple to enshrine the spirit tablets of the two empresses dowager in a shared hall with separate chambers, with seasonal offerings presented according to Grand Temple ritual.

sentences.zh: 別立廟名，自為樂曲，以崇世享。

translations.literal: Establish a separate temple name and compose music in its own right, to exalt worship for generations.
translations.idiomatic: A separate temple name should be established and a dedicated hymn composed, to exalt worship for generations.

sentences.zh: 忌前一日，不禦正殿，百官奉慰，著之令甲。」

translations.literal: On the day before the death-day, the principal palace hall should not be used for court; all officials offer condolences, and this should be entered in the ordinances."
translations.idiomatic: On the day before each death-day observance, the principal palace hall should not be used for court; all officials would offer condolences, and this was to be entered in the ordinances.

sentences.zh: 乃作新廟兩廟間，名曰奉慈。

translations.literal: Then a new temple was built between the two temples, named Fengci.
translations.idiomatic: A new temple was then built between the two temples, named Fengci.

sentences.zh: 慶曆四年，從呂公綽言：「先帝特諡二後莊懷、莊穆，及上真宗文明武定章聖元孝之諡，郭后升祔，當正徽號，宜於郊禮前遣官先上寶冊，改『莊』為『章』，止告太廟，更不改題。」

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qingli, following Lü Gongchuo's statement: "The former emperor specially bestowed posthumous titles on the two empresses Zhuanghuai and Zhuangmu, and when the present emperor bestowed on Zhenzong the posthumous title of Civil, Brilliant, Martial, and Settled, Sagely, Primordial, and Filial, with Empress Guo elevated to enshrinement, the honorific title should be corrected. Before the suburban sacrifice, officials should be dispatched to present the precious patent first, changing 'Zhuang' to 'Zhang,' reporting only to the Grand Temple without changing the inscription."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Qingli, following Lü Gongchuo's proposal: "The former emperor had specially bestowed posthumous titles on the two empresses Zhuanghuai and Zhuangmu, and when the present emperor bestowed on Zhenzong the posthumous title of Civil, Brilliant, Martial, and Settled, Sagely, Primordial, and Filial, with Empress Guo elevated to enshrinement, the honorific title should be corrected. Before the suburban sacrifice, officials should be dispatched to present the precious patent first, changing 'Zhuang' to 'Zhang,' with notification only to the Grand Temple and without changing the inscription.

sentences.zh: 遂如故事。

translations.literal: This then followed precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The court then followed precedent.

sentences.zh: 將郊，所司導五後寶冊赴三廟，各於神門外幄次以待。

translations.literal: When the suburban sacrifice was imminent, the relevant offices escorted the precious patents of the five empresses to the three temples, each waiting outside the spirit gate in a canopy shelter.
translations.idiomatic: When the suburban sacrifice was imminent, the relevant offices escorted the precious patents of the five empresses to the three temples, each waiting outside the spirit gate in a canopy shelter.

sentences.zh: 奏告畢，皆納於室。

translations.literal: When the memorial announcement was complete, all were stored in the chamber.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial announcement was complete, all were stored in their chambers.

sentences.zh: 俄又詔中書門下令禮官考故事，升祔章懿神主。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward another edict ordered the Secretariat to command ritual officials to examine precedent and elevate Empress Zhangyi's spirit tablet to enshrinement.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward another edict ordered the Secretariat to command ritual officials to examine precedent and elevate Empress Zhangyi's spirit tablet to enshrinement.

sentences.zh: 禮院言：「章獻、章懿宜序章穆之次，章惠先朝遺製嘗踐太妃，至明道中始加懿號，與章懷頗同，請序章懷之次。

translations.literal: The Board of Rites stated: "Empresses Zhangxian and Zhangyi should be ordered after Empress Zhangmu; Empress Zhanghui, by the former dynasty's established practice, had once served as Grand Consort, and only in the Mingdao era received the posthumous title of honor—this is rather the same as Empress Zhanghuai; it is requested that she be ordered after Empress Zhanghuai.
translations.idiomatic: The Board of Rites stated: "Empresses Zhangxian and Zhangyi should be ordered after Empress Zhangmu; Empress Zhanghui, by the former dynasty's established practice, had once served as Grand Consort, and only in the Mingdao era received a posthumous title of honor—this closely resembles Empress Zhanghuai; she should be ordered after Empress Zhanghuai.

sentences.zh: 太者生事之禮，不當施於宗廟。

translations.literal: The character "Grand" is a rite for one's living parent and should not be applied in the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: The character "Grand" is a title for one's living parent and should not be applied in the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 章獻以顧托之重，臨御之勞，欲稱別廟，義無所嫌，屬之配室，禮或未順。」

translations.literal: Empress Zhangxian, because of the weight of entrustment and the labor of presiding over the court, wished to be called by a separate temple name—there is nothing objectionable in principle—but assigning her to an associated chamber may not accord with ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Zhangxian, because of the weight of entrustment and the labor of presiding over the court, wished to be distinguished by a separate temple name—nothing objectionable in principle—but assigning her to an associated chamber might not accord with ritual.

sentences.zh: 學士王堯臣等言：「章獻明肅盛烈丕功，非一惠可舉，諡告於廟，冊藏於陵，無容追減。

translations.literal: Academician Wang Yaochen and others stated: "Empress Zhangxian's illustrious purity, majestic merit, and great achievements cannot be summed up in a single 'Hui.' The posthumous title was announced at the temple and the patent stored at the mausoleum—there is no room for reduction.
translations.idiomatic: Academician Wang Yaochen and others stated: "Empress Zhangxian's illustrious purity, majestic merit, and great achievements cannot be summed up in a single 'Hui.' Her posthumous title had been announced at the temple and the patent stored at the mausoleum—there was no room for reduction.

sentences.zh: 章惠擁祐帝躬，並均顧復，故景祐中膺保慶之冊，義專係子，禮須別祠。

translations.literal: Empress Zhanghui supported and nurtured the emperor's person, equally sharing in care and restoration; therefore in the Jingyou era she received the patent of Baoqing—her relationship was specifically to the son, and ritual requires separate worship.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Zhanghui had supported and nurtured the emperor, equally sharing in his care; therefore in the Jingyou era she received the patent of Baoqing—her relationship was specifically to the son, and ritual required separate worship.

sentences.zh: 章穆升附，歲月已深。

translations.literal: Empress Zhangmu's elevation to enshrinement has already been long.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Zhangmu's elevation to enshrinement was already long established.

sentences.zh: 奉慈三室，先後已定，若再議升降，則情有重輕，請如舊制。」

translations.literal: The three chambers of Fengci have had their precedence fixed; if precedence is debated again, sentiment will be weighted unevenly—it is requested that the former regulations be followed."
translations.idiomatic: The three chambers of Fengci had had their precedence fixed; if precedence were debated again, sentiment would be weighted unevenly—they requested that the former regulations be followed.

sentences.zh: 中書門下覆議：「成憲在前，文考之意；

translations.literal: The Secretariat deliberated again: "The completed constitution comes first—this is the intent of the deceased father;
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat deliberated again: "The completed constitution comes first—this reflects the deceased father's intent;

sentences.zh: 配食一體，二慈之宜；

translations.literal: associated sacrifice is a single body—the appropriateness of the two Ci;
translations.idiomatic: associated sacrifice forms a single body—the appropriateness of the two Ci;

sentences.zh: 奉承無私，陛下之孝。

translations.literal: receiving and serving without partiality—this is Your Majesty's filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: receiving and serving without partiality—this is Your Majesty's filial piety.

sentences.zh: 請如禮官及學士議。

translations.literal: It is requested that the deliberations of ritual officials and academicians be followed.
translations.idiomatic: They requested that the deliberations of ritual officials and academicians be followed.

sentences.zh: 案祥符詔係章聖特旨，位敘先後，乞聖製定數，昭示無窮。」

translations.literal: Examining the Xiangfu edict, it was tied to a special directive of Emperor Zhangsheng; as to ordering precedence, it is hoped the imperial decision will fix the number and proclaim it for endless generations."
translations.idiomatic: Examining the Xiangfu edict, it was tied to a special directive of Emperor Zhangsheng; as to ordering precedence, they hoped the imperial decision would fix the sequence and proclaim it for endless generations.

sentences.zh: 詔依所議。

translations.literal: An edict approved the deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the deliberation.

sentences.zh: 十月，文德殿奉安寶冊，帝服通天冠、絳紗袍，執圭。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the precious patent was installed with reverence in the Wende Hall; the emperor wore the Tongtian cap and crimson gauze robe and held the gui.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the precious patent was installed with reverence in the Wende Hall; the emperor wore the Tongtian cap and crimson gauze robe and held the gui.

sentences.zh: 太常奏樂，百官宿廟堂。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices performed music; all officials lodged overnight in the temple hall.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices performed music; all officials lodged overnight in the temple hall.

sentences.zh: 次日，有司薦享諸廟。

translations.literal: On the following day, the relevant offices presented offerings at the various temples.
translations.idiomatic: On the following day, the relevant offices presented offerings at the various temples.

sentences.zh: 寅時，復詣正衙，宰臣、行事官讚導冊寶至大慶殿庭發冊，出宣德門，攝太尉賈昌朝、陳執中受以赴奉慈廟上寶冊，告遷二主，皆塗「太」字，祔於太廟。

translations.literal: At the hour yin, the emperor again proceeded to the principal court; the chief ministers and officiating officials praised and escorted the patent and treasure to the Daqing Hall courtyard to issue the patent, exited Xuande Gate, and Acting Grand Commandant Jia Changchao and Chen Zhizhong received them and proceeded to Fengci Temple to present the precious patent, announcing the transfer of the two principals; both had the character "Grand" added and were enshrined in the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: At the hour yin, the emperor again proceeded to the principal court; the chief ministers and officiating officials praised and escorted the patent and treasure to the Daqing Hall courtyard to issue the patent, exited Xuande Gate, and Acting Grand Commandant Jia Changchao and Chen Zhizhong received them and proceeded to Fengci Temple to present the precious patent, announcing the transfer of the two principals; both had the character "Grand" added and were enshrined in the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 至和元年七月，有司奉詔立溫成皇后廟，享祭器數視皇后廟。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Zhihe, the relevant offices received an edict to establish a temple for Empress Wencheng, with sacrificial vessels numbering as for an empress temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Zhihe, the relevant offices received an edict to establish a temple for Empress Wencheng, with sacrificial vessels numbering as for an empress temple.

sentences.zh: 後以諫官言，改為祠殿，歲時令宮臣薦以常饌。

translations.literal: Later, because remonstrance officials spoke, it was changed to a shrine hall; each season palace officials were commanded to present regular offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because remonstrance officials spoke out, it was changed to a shrine hall; each season palace officials were commanded to present regular offerings.

sentences.zh: 治平元年，同判太常寺呂公著言：「按《喪服小記》『慈母不世祭』。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhiping, Lü Gongzhu, Associate Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, stated: "According to the 《Record of Mourning Garments · Summary Account》, 'A nurturing mother is not sacrificed to in perpetuity.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhiping, Lü Gongzhu, Associate Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, stated: "According to the 《Record of Mourning Garments · Summary Account》, 'A nurturing mother is not sacrificed to in perpetuity.

sentences.zh: 章惠太后，仁宗嘗以母稱，故加保慶之號。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Zhanghui—Renzong once addressed her as mother—therefore the title of Baoqing was added.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Zhanghui—Renzong had once addressed her as mother—therefore the title of Baoqing was added.

sentences.zh: 蓋生有慈保之勤，故沒有廟享之報。

translations.literal: This is because in life there was the diligence of nurturing and protecting; therefore after death there is the reward of temple worship.
translations.idiomatic: Because in life there had been the diligence of nurturing and protecting, after death there was the reward of temple worship.

sentences.zh: 今於陛下恩有所止，禮難承祀，其奉慈廟，乞依禮廢罷。」

translations.literal: Now with regard to Your Majesty's affection there is a limit, and ritual makes it difficult to continue sacrifice—Fengci Temple is requested to be abolished according to ritual."
translations.idiomatic: Now with regard to Your Majesty's affection there is a limit, and ritual makes it difficult to continue sacrifice—Fengci Temple should be abolished according to ritual."

sentences.zh: 熙寧二年，命攝太常卿張掞奉章惠太后神主瘞陵園。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xining, Zhang Yan, Acting Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was ordered to bury Empress Dowager Zhanghui's spirit tablet at the mausoleum park.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xining, Zhang Yan, Acting Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was ordered to bury Empress Dowager Zhanghui's spirit tablet at the mausoleum park.

sentences.zh: 元豐六年，詳定所言：「按《禮》，夫婦一體，故昏則同牢、合巹，終則同穴，祭則同幾、同祝饌，未嘗有異廟者也。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yuanfeng, the Detailed Determination Office stated: "According to the 《Rites》, husband and wife are a single body; therefore at marriage they share the same mat and joined goblet, at death the same grave, and at sacrifice the same spirit table and sacrificial offering—there has never been a separate temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Yuanfeng, the Detailed Determination Office stated: "According to the 《Rites》, husband and wife are a single body; therefore at marriage they share the same mat and joined goblet, at death the same grave, and at sacrifice the same spirit table and sacrificial offering—there has never been a separate temple.

sentences.zh: 惟周人以薑原為媒神，而帝嚳無廟，又不可下入子孫之廟，乃以別廟而祭，故《魯頌》謂之宮，《周禮》謂之先妣，可也。

translations.literal: Only the Zhou took Jiang Yuan as a matchmaking spirit, while Emperor Ku had no temple and could not be placed below in descendants' temples; therefore a separate temple was used for sacrifice—thus the 《Odes of Lu》 calls it Gong, and the 《Rites of Zhou》 calls it the former mother, which is acceptable.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Zhou took Jiang Yuan as a matchmaking spirit, while Emperor Ku had no temple and could not be placed in descendants' temples; therefore a separate temple was used for sacrifice—thus the 《Odes of Lu》 calls it Gong, and the 《Rites of Zhou》 calls it the former mother, which is acceptable.

sentences.zh: 自漢以來，不祔不配者，皆援薑原為比，或以其微，或以其繼而已。

translations.literal: Since Han times, those neither enshrined nor given associated sacrifice have all cited Jiang Yuan as precedent, either because of their humble origin or because they were successors.
translations.idiomatic: Since Han times, those neither enshrined nor given associated sacrifice have all cited Jiang Yuan as precedent, either because of their humble origin or because they were successors.

sentences.zh: 蓋其間有天下者，起於側微，而其後不及正位中宮，或以嘗正位矣，有所不幸，則當立繼以奉宗廟，故有『祖姑三人則祔於親者』之說。

translations.literal: Among them, those who gained the realm began from humble side positions, and afterward did not reach the principal position in the inner palace; or if they had once held the principal position but met misfortune, then a successor should be established to serve the ancestral temple—hence the saying 'if there are three paternal grandmothers-in-law, enshrine with the intimate one.'
translations.idiomatic: Among them, those who gained the realm often began from humble side positions and afterward did not reach the principal place in the inner palace; or if they had once held the principal position but met misfortune, a successor should be established to serve the ancestral temple—hence the saying 'if there are three paternal grandmothers-in-law, enshrine with the intimate one.'

sentences.zh: 立繼之禮，其來尚矣。

translations.literal: The rite of establishing a successor has long had high antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: The rite of establishing a successor dates to high antiquity.

sentences.zh: 始微終顯，皆嫡也，前娶後繼，皆嫡也。

translations.literal: Beginning humble and ending illustrious—both are principal wives; marrying first and succeeding afterward—both are principal wives.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning humble and ending illustrious—both count as principal wives; marrying first and succeeding afterward—both count as principal wives.

sentences.zh: 後世乃以始微後繼置之別廟，不得伸同幾之義，則非禮意。

translations.literal: Later ages placed those who began humble and succeeded afterward in separate temples, unable to extend the meaning of sharing the same spirit table—this is not the intent of ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Later ages placed those who began humble and succeeded afterward in separate temples, unable to extend the meaning of sharing the same spirit table—this is not the intent of ritual.

sentences.zh: 恭惟太祖孝惠皇后、太宗淑德皇后、真宗章懷皇后實皆元妃，而孝章則太祖繼後，乃皆祭以別廟，在禮未安，請升祔太廟，增四室，以時配享。」

translations.literal: Respectfully, Empresses Xiaohui of Taizu, Shude of Taizong, and Zhanghuai of Zhenzong were in fact all original consorts, while Empress Xiaozhang was Taizu's successor empress—yet all are sacrificed to in separate temples, which in ritual is not secure. It is requested that they be elevated to enshrinement in the Grand Temple, with four chambers added for seasonal associated sacrifice."
translations.idiomatic: Respectfully, Empresses Xiaohui of Taizu, Shude of Taizong, and Zhanghuai of Zhenzong were in fact all original consorts, while Empress Xiaozhang was Taizu's successor empress—yet all were sacrificed to in separate temples, which in ritual was not secure. They requested that they be elevated to enshrinement in the Grand Temple, with four chambers added for seasonal associated sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 七月，遂自別廟升祔焉。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, they were elevated to enshrinement from the separate temples.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, they were elevated to enshrinement from the separate temples.

sentences.zh: 政和四年，有司言：「政和元年孟冬祫享，奉惠恭神主入太廟，祔於祖姑之下。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhenghe, the relevant offices stated: "At the cha sacrifice in the first month of winter of the first year of Zhenghe, the spirit tablet of Empress Huigong was brought into the Grand Temple and enshrined below the paternal grandmother-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhenghe, the relevant offices stated: "At the cha sacrifice in the first month of winter of the first year of Zhenghe, the spirit tablet of Empress Huigong was brought into the Grand Temple and enshrined below the paternal grandmother-in-law.

sentences.zh: 今歲當祫，而明達皇后神主奉安陵祠，緣在城外。

translations.literal: This year should be cha, but the spirit tablet of Empress Mingda is installed at the mausoleum shrine, because it is outside the city.
translations.idiomatic: This year should be cha, but the spirit tablet of Empress Mingda is installed at the mausoleum shrine, because it lies outside the city.

sentences.zh: 三代之制，未有即陵以為廟者。

translations.literal: The institutions of the Three Dynasties had none that made the tomb immediately into a temple.
translations.idiomatic: The institutions of the Three Dynasties had none that made the tomb immediately into a temple.

sentences.zh: 今明達皇后追正典冊，歲時薦享，並同諸後，宜就惠恭別廟增建殿室，迎奉神主以祔。」

translations.literal: Now Empress Mingda has been corrected in canonical patent; seasonal offerings and sacrifices are the same as for other empresses—it is fitting to add a hall chamber at the separate temple of Huigong and welcome the spirit tablet for enshrinement."
translations.idiomatic: Now Empress Mingda has been corrected in canonical patent; seasonal offerings and sacrifices are the same as for other empresses—it is fitting to add a hall chamber at the separate temple of Huigong and welcome the spirit tablet for enshrinement.

sentences.zh: 又言：「明達神主祔謁日，於英宗室增設宣仁聖烈皇后、明達皇后二位，及遍祭七祀、配享功臣，並別廟祔享惠恭、明達二位。」

translations.literal: They also stated: "On the day of the enshrinement audience for Empress Mingda's spirit tablet, two places for Empresses Xuanren, Shenglie, and Mingda were added in Emperor Yingzong's chamber, and at the universal sacrifice to the seven shrines and associated offerings for meritorious ministers, the two of Huigong and Mingda were also enshrined for sacrifice at the separate temple."
translations.idiomatic: They also stated: "On the day of the enshrinement audience for Empress Mingda's spirit tablet, two places for Empresses Xuanren, Shenglie, and Mingda were added in Emperor Yingzong's chamber, and at the universal sacrifice to the seven shrines and associated offerings for meritorious ministers, Huigong and Mingda were also enshrined for sacrifice at the separate temple."

sentences.zh: 紹興七年，惠恭改諡為顯恭，以上徽宗聖文仁德顯孝之諡故也。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Shaoxing, Huigong's posthumous title was changed to Xiangong, because of the posthumous title of Sagely, Civil, Benevolent, and Manifestly Filial bestowed on Huizong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Shaoxing, Huigong's posthumous title was changed to Xiangong, because of the posthumous title of Sagely, Civil, Benevolent, and Manifestly Filial bestowed on Huizong.

sentences.zh: 十二年五月，禮部侍郎施言：「懿節皇后神主，候至卒哭擇日祔廟，合依顯恭皇后禮，於太廟內修建殿室，以為別廟安奉。」

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twelfth year, Vice Minister of Rites Shi stated: "The spirit tablet of Empress Yijie—when the day is chosen after the end of wailing for enshrinement in the temple—should follow the ritual of Empress Xiangong, constructing a hall chamber within the Grand Temple as a separate temple for installation."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twelfth year, Vice Minister of Rites Shi stated: "The spirit tablet of Empress Yijie—when the day is chosen after the end of wailing for enshrinement in the temple—should follow the ritual of Empress Xiangong, constructing a hall chamber within the Grand Temple as a separate temple for installation.

sentences.zh: 又言：「將來祔廟，其虞主合於本室後瘞埋。

translations.literal: They also stated: "When enshrined in the temple in the future, the mourning tablet should be buried behind the original chamber.
translations.idiomatic: They also stated: "When enshrined in the temple in the future, the mourning tablet should be buried behind the original chamber.

sentences.zh: 緣別係行在祔廟，欲於本室冊寶殿收奉，候回京日依別廟故事。」

translations.literal: Because the separate enshrinement is at the traveling capital, it is desired to store it in the patent and treasure hall of the original chamber; when the capital is returned to, follow the precedent of separate temples."
translations.idiomatic: Because the separate enshrinement was at the traveling capital, it was desired to store it in the patent and treasure hall of the original chamber; when the capital was returned to, they would follow the precedent of separate temples.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 七月，有司行九虞之祭奉安。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the relevant offices performed the nine yu sacrifices for installation with reverence.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the relevant offices performed the nine yu sacrifices for installation with reverence.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，禮部、太常言：「故妃郭氏追冊為皇后，合依懿節皇后祭於別廟。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, the Ministry of Rites and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "The former consort Lady Guo, posthumously enfeoffed as empress, should be sacrificed to at a separate temple following Empress Yijie.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year, the Ministry of Rites and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "The former consort Lady Guo, posthumously enfeoffed as empress, should be sacrificed to at a separate temple following Empress Yijie.

sentences.zh: 所有廟殿，見安懿節皇后神主，行禮狹隘。

translations.literal: The existing temple hall now has Empress Yijie's spirit tablet installed; the performance of ritual is cramped.
translations.idiomatic: The existing temple hall now has Empress Yijie's spirit tablet installed; the performance of ritual is cramped.

sentences.zh: 乞分為二室，以西為上，各置戶牖，及擗截本廟齋宮，權安懿節神主，工畢還殿。」

translations.literal: It is requested that it be divided into two chambers, with the west as superior, each provided with doors and windows, and the fasting palace of the original temple cut apart to temporarily install Empress Yijie's spirit tablet; when the work is complete, return to the hall."
translations.idiomatic: It is requested that it be divided into two chambers, with the west as superior, each provided with doors and windows, and the fasting palace of the original temple cut apart to temporarily install Empress Yijie's spirit tablet; when the work is complete, return to the hall.

sentences.zh: 王普又請各置祏室。

translations.literal: Wang Pu also requested that each have a spirit chamber established.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Pu also requested that each have a spirit chamber established.

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 乾道三年閏七月，安恭皇后神主祔於別廟，為三室。

translations.literal: In the intercalary seventh month of the third year of Qiandao, the spirit tablet of Empress Angong was enshrined in the separate temple, making three chambers.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month of the third year of Qiandao, the spirit tablet of Empress Angong was enshrined in the separate temple, making three chambers.

sentences.zh: 景靈宮。

translations.literal: Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 創於大中祥符五年，聖祖臨降，為宮以奉之。

translations.literal: It was founded in the fifth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, when the Sagely Ancestor descended and a palace was built to receive him.
translations.idiomatic: It was founded in the fifth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, when the Sagely Ancestor descended and a palace was built to receive him.

sentences.zh: 天聖元年，詔修宮之萬壽殿以奉真宗，署曰奉真。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiansheng, an edict ordered the Wanshou Hall of the palace repaired to receive Zhenzong, titled Fengzhen.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tiansheng, an edict ordered the Wanshou Hall of the palace repaired to receive Zhenzong, titled Fengzhen.

sentences.zh: 明道二年，又建廣孝殿，奉安章懿皇后。

translations.literal: In the second year of Mingdao, the Guangxiao Hall was also built to install Empress Zhangyi with reverence.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Mingdao, the Guangxiao Hall was also built to install Empress Zhangyi with reverence.

sentences.zh: 治平元年，又詔就宮之西園建殿，以奉仁宗，署曰孝嚴，奉安御容，親行酌獻，命大臣分詣諸神御代行禮。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhiping, another edict ordered a hall built in the palace's western garden to receive Renzong, titled Xiaoyan, installing the imperial likeness; the emperor personally performed libation and offering, commanding great ministers to proceed to the various spirit likenesses to perform ritual in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhiping, another edict ordered a hall built in the palace's western garden to receive Renzong, titled Xiaoyan, installing the imperial likeness; the emperor personally performed libation and offering, commanding great ministers to proceed to the various spirit likenesses to perform ritual in his stead.

sentences.zh: 翼日，太后酌獻，皇后、大長公主以下內外命婦陪位於廷。

translations.literal: On the following day, the empress dowager performed libation and offering; the empress, grand princesses, and inner and outer titled ladies attended in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: On the following day, the empress dowager performed libation and offering; the empress, grand princesses, and inner and outer titled ladies attended in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 詔每歲下元朝謁，如奉真殿儀，有期以上喪或災異，則命輔臣攝事。

translations.literal: An edict directed that each year on the Lower Primordial festival the palace be visited, following the ritual of the Fengzhen Hall; if there was mourning above the stipulated period or natural disaster, then assisting ministers were commanded to officiate.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that each year on the Lower Primordial festival the palace be visited, following the ritual of the Fengzhen Hall; if there was mourning above the stipulated period or natural disaster, assisting ministers were commanded to officiate.

sentences.zh: 名齋殿曰迎厘，宮西門曰廣祐。

translations.literal: The fasting hall was named Yingli; the palace's western gate was named Guangyou.
translations.idiomatic: The fasting hall was named Yingli; the palace's western gate was named Guangyou.

sentences.zh: 四年，建英德殿，奉英宗神御。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the Yingde Hall was built to receive Yingzong's spirit likeness.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, the Yingde Hall was built to receive Yingzong's spirit likeness.

sentences.zh: 凡七十年間，神御在宮者四，寓寺觀者十有一。

translations.literal: Over seventy years, spirit likenesses in the palace numbered four; those lodged at temples and monasteries numbered eleven.
translations.idiomatic: Over seventy years, spirit likenesses in the palace numbered four; those lodged at temples and monasteries numbered eleven.

sentences.zh: 元豐五年，始就宮作十一殿，悉迎在京寺觀神御入內，盡合帝後，奉以時王之禮。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yuanfeng, eleven halls were first built at the palace; all spirit likenesses at capital temples and monasteries were welcomed inside, fully combining emperors and empresses, received with the ritual of the reigning king.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Yuanfeng, eleven halls were first built at the palace; all spirit likenesses at capital temples and monasteries were welcomed inside, fully combining emperors and empresses, received with the ritual of the reigning king.

sentences.zh: 十一月，百官班於集英殿廷，帝詣蕊珠、凝華等殿，行告遷廟禮，禮儀使奉神御升彩輿出殿。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, all officials were arrayed in the courtyard of the Hall of Assembled Elegance; the emperor proceeded to the Ruizhu, Ninghua, and other halls to perform the ritual of announcing transfer from the temple; the Commissioner of Ritual Protocol bore the spirit likeness up in the colored carriage and exited the hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, all officials were arrayed in the courtyard of the Hall of Assembled Elegance; the emperor proceeded to the Ruizhu, Ninghua, and other halls to perform the ritual of announcing transfer from the temple; the Commissioner of Ritual Protocol bore the spirit likeness up in the colored carriage and exited the hall.

sentences.zh: 明日，復行薦享如禮，禮儀使奉神輿行，帝出幄，導至宣德門外，親王、使相、宗室正任以上前引，望參官及諸軍都虞候、宗室副率以上陪位，內侍省押班整儀衛以從，奉安神御於十一殿。

translations.literal: On the following day, offering sacrifice was again performed according to ritual; the Commissioner of Ritual Protocol bore the spirit carriage in procession; the emperor exited the canopy, escorted to outside Xuande Gate; princes, commissioners with seals, imperial clansmen of regular appointment and above led in front; officials awaiting audience and all army commanders-in-chief, imperial clansmen of deputy command rank and above attended; the Inner Service Directorate arranged the guard of honor to follow, and the spirit likeness was installed with reverence in the eleven halls.
