translations.idiomatic: On the following day, offering sacrifice was again performed according to ritual; the Commissioner of Ritual Protocol bore the spirit carriage in procession; the emperor exited the canopy, escorted to outside Xuande Gate; princes, commissioners with seals, imperial clansmen of regular appointment and above led in front; officials awaiting audience and all army commanders-in-chief, imperial clansmen of deputy command rank and above attended; the Inner Service Directorate arranged the guard of honor to follow, and the spirit likeness was installed with reverence in the eleven halls.

sentences.zh: 明日，帝詣宮朝獻，先謁天興殿，以次行禮，並如四孟儀。

translations.literal: On the following day, the emperor proceeded to the palace for morning offering; first visiting the Tianxing Hall, then performing ritual in order, all following the ritual of the four meng months.
translations.idiomatic: On the following day, the emperor proceeded to the palace for morning offering; first visiting the Tianxing Hall, then performing ritual in order, all following the ritual of the four meng months.

sentences.zh: 詔自今朝獻孟春用十一日，孟夏擇日，孟秋用中元日，孟冬用下元日，天子常服行事。

translations.literal: An edict directed that from this morning offering, the first meng month of spring use the eleventh day; the first meng month of summer choose a day; the first meng month of autumn use the Zhongyuan day; the first meng month of winter use the Lower Primordial day—the Son of Heaven wearing regular dress to officiate.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that from this morning offering, the first meng month of spring use the eleventh day; the first meng month of summer choose a day; the first meng month of autumn use the Zhongyuan day; the first meng month of winter use the Lower Primordial day—the Son of Heaven wearing regular dress to officiate.

sentences.zh: 薦聖祖殿以素饌，神御殿以膳羞，器服儀物，悉從今制。

translations.literal: The Sagely Ancestor's hall was offered plain fare; the spirit likeness halls were offered delicacies; vessels, dress, and ritual objects all followed the present regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Sagely Ancestor's hall was offered plain fare; the spirit likeness halls were offered delicacies; vessels, dress, and ritual objects all followed the present regulations.

sentences.zh: 天興殿門以奉天神不立戟，諸神御門置親事官五百人，立戟二十四。

translations.literal: The Tianxing Hall gate, because it worships the Heavenly Spirit, does not set halberds; the spirit likeness hall gates set five hundred personal attendant officials and twenty-four halberds.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianxing Hall gate, because it worships the Heavenly Spirit, does not set halberds; the spirit likeness hall gates set five hundred personal attendant officials and twenty-four halberds.

sentences.zh: 累朝文武執政官、武臣節度使以上並圖形於兩廡。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials who had held governing office through successive reigns, and military officials of frontier commissioner rank and above, all had their likenesses painted in the two side corridors.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials who had held governing office through successive reigns, and military officials of frontier commissioner rank and above, all had their likenesses painted in the two side corridors.

sentences.zh: 凡執政官除拜，赴官恭謝。

translations.literal: Whenever a governing official received appointment, he proceeded to his post and offered respectful thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever a governing official received appointment, he proceeded to his post and offered respectful thanks.

sentences.zh: 其後南郊先詣宮行薦享禮，並如太廟儀。

translations.literal: Afterward, before the southern suburban sacrifice, the palace was first visited to perform the offering sacrifice ritual, all following Grand Temple ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, before the southern suburban sacrifice, the palace was first visited to perform the offering sacrifice ritual, all following Grand Temple ritual.

sentences.zh: 元祐元年，太常寺言：「季秋有事於明堂，其朝享景靈宮、親享太廟，當用三年不祭之禮，遣大臣攝事。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanyou, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "In the third meng month of autumn there will be affairs at the Bright Hall; the morning offering at Jingling Palace and personal enjoyment of the Grand Temple should use the ritual of not sacrificing for three years—great ministers should be dispatched to officiate."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanyou, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "In the third meng month of autumn there will be affairs at the Bright Hall; the morning offering at Jingling Palace and personal enjoyment of the Grand Temple should use the ritual of not sacrificing for three years—great ministers should be dispatched to officiate.

sentences.zh: 禮部言：「景靈宮天興殿，用天地之禮，即非廟享，於典禮無違。」

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites stated: "The Tianxing Hall of Jingling Palace uses the ritual of Heaven and Earth—it is not temple worship and does not violate canonical ritual."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites stated: "The Tianxing Hall of Jingling Palace uses the ritual of Heaven and Earth—it is not temple worship and does not violate canonical ritual.

sentences.zh: 詔明堂前二日朝享景靈宮天興殿。

translations.literal: An edict directed that two days before the Bright Hall, the Tianxing Hall of Jingling Palace be visited for morning offering.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that two days before the Bright Hall, the Tianxing Hall of Jingling Palace be visited for morning offering.

sentences.zh: 明年，奉安神宗神御於景靈宮，如十一殿奉安之禮。

translations.literal: In the following year, Emperor Shenzong's spirit likeness was installed with reverence at Jingling Palace, following the ritual of installation in the eleven halls.
translations.idiomatic: In the following year, Emperor Shenzong's spirit likeness was installed with reverence at Jingling Palace, following the ritual of installation in the eleven halls.

sentences.zh: 舊制，車駕上元節以十一日詣興國寺、啟聖院，朝謁太祖、太宗、神宗神御，下元節詣景靈宮朝拜天興殿，朝謁真宗、仁宗、英宗神御。

translations.literal: Under the former regulations, on the Upper Primordial festival the imperial carriage proceeded on the eleventh day to Xingguo Temple and Qisheng Cloister to pay court to the spirit likenesses of Taizu, Taizong, and Shenzong; on the Lower Primordial festival it proceeded to Jingling Palace to pay court at the Tianxing Hall and pay court to the spirit likenesses of Zhenzong, Renzong, and Yingzong.
translations.idiomatic: Under the former regulations, on the Upper Primordial festival the imperial carriage proceeded on the eleventh day to Xingguo Temple and Qisheng Cloister to pay court to the spirit likenesses of Taizu, Taizong, and Shenzong; on the Lower Primordial festival it proceeded to Jingling Palace to pay court at the Tianxing Hall and pay court to the spirit likenesses of Zhenzong, Renzong, and Yingzong.

sentences.zh: 至是詔分每歲四孟月拜謁之所，自孟秋始，其不當親獻，則遣官分詣。

translations.literal: At this time an edict divided the places of court visit for each year's four meng months, beginning from the first meng month of autumn; when personal offering was not appropriate, officials were dispatched to proceed separately.
translations.idiomatic: At this time an edict divided the places of court visit for each year's four meng months, beginning from the first meng month of autumn; when personal offering was not appropriate, officials were dispatched to proceed separately.

sentences.zh: 初詣天興殿、保寧閣、天元殿、太始殿，次詣皇武殿、儷極殿、大定殿、輝德殿，次詣熙文殿、衍慶殿、美成殿，次詣治隆殿、宣光殿，

translations.literal: First visiting the Tianxing Hall, Baoning Pavilion, Tianyuan Hall, and Taishi Hall; next the Huangwu, Liji, Dading, and Huide halls; next the Xiwen, Yanqing, and Meicheng halls; next the Zhilong and Xuangguang halls,
translations.idiomatic: First visiting the Tianxing Hall, Baoning Pavilion, Tianyuan Hall, and Taishi Hall; next the Huangwu, Liji, Dading, and Huide halls; next the Xiwen, Yanqing, and Meicheng halls; next the Zhilong and Xuangguang halls,

sentences.zh: 〈（宣光後改曰顯承，徽宗又改大明殿。）〉

translations.literal: (After Xuangguang it was changed to Xiancheng; Huizong again changed it to the Daming Hall.)
translations.idiomatic: (After Xuangguang it was changed to Xiancheng; Huizong again changed it to the Daming Hall.)

sentences.zh: 仍自來年孟春為始。

translations.literal: Still beginning from the first meng month of spring of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: Still beginning from the first meng month of spring of the coming year.

sentences.zh: 皇太后崩，三省請奉安神御於治隆殿，以遵元祐初詔。

translations.literal: When the empress dowager died, the Three Departments requested installing the spirit likeness with reverence at the Zhilong Hall, following the initial Yuanyou edict.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager died, the Three Departments requested installing the spirit likeness with reverence at the Zhilong Hall, following the initial Yuanyou edict.

sentences.zh: 復以御史劉極之言，特建原廟，廟成，名神御殿曰徽音，山殿曰寧真。

translations.literal: Again because of Censor Liu Ji's statement, a separate Original Temple was specially built; when the temple was completed, the spirit likeness hall was named Huiyin and the mountain hall Ningzhen.
translations.idiomatic: Again because of Censor Liu Ji's statement, a separate Original Temple was specially built; when the temple was completed, the spirit likeness hall was named Huiyin and the mountain hall Ningzhen.

sentences.zh: 紹聖二年，奉安神宗神御於顯承殿。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaosheng, Emperor Shenzong's spirit likeness was installed with reverence at the Xiancheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shaosheng, Emperor Shenzong's spirit likeness was installed with reverence at the Xiancheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 元豐中，每歲四孟月，天子遍詣諸殿朝獻。

translations.literal: In the Yuanfeng era, each year's four meng months the Son of Heaven visited all halls for morning offering.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanfeng era, each year's four meng months the Son of Heaven visited all halls for morning offering.

sentences.zh: 元祐初，議者請以四孟分獻，一歲而遍，至是復用舊儀。

translations.literal: In the early Yuanyou era, debaters requested dividing the four meng offerings so that one year would complete the circuit; at this time the former ritual was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Yuanyou era, debaters requested dividing the four meng offerings so that one year would complete the circuit; at this time the former ritual was restored.

sentences.zh: 詔自今四孟朝獻分二日，先日詣天興殿、保寧閣、天元、太始、皇武、儷極、大定、德輝諸殿，次日詣熙文、衍慶、美成、繼仁、治隆、徽音、顯承七殿。

translations.literal: An edict directed that from now on the four meng morning offerings be divided over two days: on the first day visiting the Tianxing Hall, Baoning Pavilion, Tianyuan, Taishi, Huangwu, Liji, Dading, and Dehui halls; on the second day visiting the Xiwen, Yanqing, Meicheng, Jiren, Zhilong, Huiyin, and Xiancheng halls.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that from now on the four meng morning offerings be divided over two days: on the first day visiting the Tianxing Hall, Baoning Pavilion, Tianyuan, Taishi, Huangwu, Liji, Dading, and Dehui halls; on the second day visiting the Xiwen, Yanqing, Meicheng, Jiren, Zhilong, Huiyin, and Xiancheng halls.

sentences.zh: 三年十月，帝詣天興諸殿朝獻。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year, the emperor proceeded to the Tianxing and other halls for morning offering.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the third year, the emperor proceeded to the Tianxing and other halls for morning offering.

sentences.zh: 翼日，大雨，詔差已致齋官分獻熙文七殿，自是雨雪用為例雲。

translations.literal: On the following day, heavy rain fell; an edict directed officials who had already fasted to divide offerings at the seven Xiwen halls—henceforth rain and snow were made precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On the following day, heavy rain fell; an edict directed officials who had already fasted to divide offerings at the seven Xiwen halls—henceforth rain and snow were made precedent.

sentences.zh: 建中靖國元年，詔建欽聖憲肅皇后、欽慈皇后神御殿於大明殿北，名曰柔明。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jianzhong Jingguo, an edict ordered halls for the spirit likenesses of Empresses Qinsheng, Xiansu, and Qinci built north of the Daming Hall, named Rouming.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jianzhong Jingguo, an edict ordered halls for the spirit likenesses of Empresses Qinsheng, Xiansu, and Qinci built north of the Daming Hall, named Rouming.

sentences.zh: 〈（尋改欽儀，又改坤元。）〉

translations.literal: (Soon changed to Qinyi, then again to Kunyuan.)
translations.idiomatic: (Soon changed to Qinyi, then again to Kunyuan.)

sentences.zh: 又名哲宗神御殿曰觀成。

translations.literal: The spirit likeness hall of Zhezong was also named Guancheng.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit likeness hall of Zhezong was also named Guancheng.

sentences.zh: 〈（尋改重光。）〉

translations.literal: (Soon changed to Chongguang.)
translations.idiomatic: (Soon changed to Chongguang.)

sentences.zh: 詔自今景靈宮並分三日朝獻。

translations.literal: An edict directed that from now on Jingling Palace morning offerings be divided over three days.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that from now on Jingling Palace morning offerings be divided over three days.

sentences.zh: 崇寧三年，奉安欽成皇后神御坤元殿欽聖憲肅皇后之次，欽慈皇后又次之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongning, the spirit likeness of Empress Qincheng was installed with reverence in the Kunyuan Hall, next after Empress Qinsheng Xiansu, with Empress Qinci again next.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chongning, the spirit likeness of Empress Qincheng was installed with reverence in the Kunyuan Hall, next after Empress Qinsheng Xiansu, with Empress Qinci again next.

sentences.zh: 政和三年，奉安哲宗神御於重光殿。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenghe, Zhezong's spirit likeness was installed with reverence at the Chongguang Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhenghe, Zhezong's spirit likeness was installed with reverence at the Chongguang Hall.

sentences.zh: 昭懷皇后神御殿成，詔名正殿曰柔儀，山殿曰靈矣。

translations.literal: When the spirit likeness hall of Empress Zhaohuai was completed, an edict named the principal hall Rouyi and the mountain hall Lingyi.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirit likeness hall of Empress Zhaohuai was completed, an edict named the principal hall Rouyi and the mountain hall Lingyi.

sentences.zh: 於是兩宮合為前殿九，後殿八，山殿十六，閣一，鍾樓一，碑樓四，經閣一，齋殿三，神廚二，道院一，及齋宮廊廡，共為二千三百二十區。

translations.literal: At this time the two palaces combined into nine front halls, eight rear halls, sixteen mountain halls, one pavilion, one bell tower, four stele towers, one sutra pavilion, three fasting halls, two spirit kitchens, one Daoist abbey, and fasting palace corridors and side chambers—altogether two thousand three hundred twenty units.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the two palaces combined into nine front halls, eight rear halls, sixteen mountain halls, one pavilion, one bell tower, four stele towers, one sutra pavilion, three fasting halls, two spirit kitchens, one Daoist abbey, and fasting palace corridors and side chambers—altogether two thousand three hundred twenty units.

sentences.zh: 初，東京以來奉先之制，太廟以奉神主，歲五享，宗室諸王行事；

translations.literal: Initially, since the establishment of the Eastern Capital, the regulations for honoring ancestors: the Grand Temple received spirit tablets, with five seasonal sacrifices, imperial clansmen and princes officiating;
translations.idiomatic: Initially, since the establishment of the Eastern Capital, the regulations for honoring ancestors were as follows: the Grand Temple received spirit tablets, with five seasonal sacrifices officiated by imperial clansmen and princes;

sentences.zh: 朔祭而月薦新，則太常卿行事。

translations.literal: the first-day sacrifice and monthly presentation of new offerings were performed by the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: the first-day sacrifice and monthly presentation of new offerings were performed by the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 景靈宮以奉塑像，歲四孟皇帝親享，帝後大忌，則宰相率百官行香，后妃繼之。

translations.literal: Jingling Palace received sculpted likenesses; each year's four meng months the emperor enjoyed sacrifice in person; on the great death-days of emperors and empresses, the chief minister led all officials to offer incense, followed by consorts.
translations.idiomatic: Jingling Palace received sculpted likenesses; in each year's four meng months the emperor enjoyed sacrifice in person; on the great death-days of emperors and empresses, the chief minister led all officials to offer incense, followed by consorts.

sentences.zh: 遇郊祀、明堂大禮，則先期二日，親詣景靈宮行朝享禮。

translations.literal: When suburban sacrifice or Bright Hall great ritual occurred, two days beforehand the emperor personally proceeded to Jingling Palace to perform the morning offering ritual.
translations.idiomatic: When suburban sacrifice or Bright Hall great ritual occurred, two days beforehand the emperor personally proceeded to Jingling Palace to perform the morning offering ritual.

sentences.zh: 紹興十三年二月，臣僚言：「竊見元豐五年，神宗始廣景靈宮以奉祖宗衣冠之遊，即漢之原廟也。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirteenth year of Shaoxing, officials stated: "We have observed that in the fifth year of Yuanfeng, Shenzong first expanded Jingling Palace to receive the traveling likenesses of ancestors' robes and caps—this is the Han Original Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the thirteenth year of Shaoxing, officials stated: "We have observed that in the fifth year of Yuanfeng, Shenzong first expanded Jingling Palace to receive the traveling likenesses of ancestors' robes and caps—this is the Han Original Temple.

sentences.zh: 自艱難以來，庶事草創，始建宗廟，而原廟神遊猶寄永嘉。

translations.literal: Since the hardships, all affairs have been hastily established; the ancestral temple was first built, yet the Original Temple spirit journey still lodges at Yongjia.
translations.idiomatic: Since the hardships, all affairs have been hastily established; the ancestral temple was first built, yet the Original Temple spirit journey still lodges at Yongjia.

sentences.zh: 乃者權時之宜，四孟薦獻，旋即便朝設位以享，未副廣孝之意，乞命有司擇爽塏之地，仿景靈宮舊規，隨宜建置。

translations.literal: For the present, as a temporary measure, the four meng offerings and presentations are performed with seats set up at once in the court for worship, which does not fulfill the intent of broad filial piety. It is requested that the relevant offices choose open high ground, following the old regulations of Jingling Palace, and build as circumstances permit.
translations.idiomatic: For the present, as a temporary measure, the four meng offerings are performed with seats set up at once in the court for worship, which does not fulfill the intent of broad filial piety. It is requested that the relevant offices choose open high ground, following the old regulations of Jingling Palace, and build as circumstances permit.

sentences.zh: 俟告成有日，迎還晬容，奉安新廟，庶幾四孟躬行獻禮，用副罔極之恩。」

translations.literal: When completion is announced, welcome back the bright likeness, install it with reverence in the new temple—then the four meng may be performed in person with offering ritual, fulfilling boundless grace."
translations.idiomatic: When completion is announced, welcome back the bright likeness and install it with reverence in the new temple—then the four meng may be performed in person with offering ritual, fulfilling boundless grace.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 初築三殿，聖祖居前，宣祖至祖宗諸帝居中殿，元天大聖後與祖宗諸後居後。

translations.literal: When first building the three halls, the Sagely Ancestor was placed in front; from the Exalted Ancestor through the various emperors in the central hall; the Great Sage of Primordial Heaven and the various empresses of ancestors in the rear.
translations.idiomatic: When first building the three halls, the Sagely Ancestor was placed in front; from the Exalted Ancestor through the various emperors in the central hall; the Great Sage of Primordial Heaven and the various empresses of ancestors in the rear.

sentences.zh: 掌宮內侍七人，道士十人，吏卒二百七十六人。

translations.literal: Seven inner attendants managed the palace, ten Daoist priests, and two hundred seventy-six clerks and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Seven inner attendants managed the palace, ten Daoist priests, and two hundred seventy-six clerks and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 上元結燈樓，寒食設秋千，七夕設摩睺羅。

translations.literal: On the Upper Primordial festival, lantern towers were set up; on Cold Food, swings; on the Seventh Night, Matuoluo figures.
translations.idiomatic: On the Upper Primordial festival, lantern towers were set up; on Cold Food, swings; on the Seventh Night, Matuoluo figures.

sentences.zh: 簾幕歲時一易，歲用酌獻二百四十羊。

translations.literal: Curtains and screens were changed once a year; each year two hundred forty sheep were used for libation offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Curtains and screens were changed once a year; each year two hundred forty sheep were used for libation offerings.

sentences.zh: 凡帝後忌辰，用道、釋作法事。

translations.literal: On the death-days of all emperors and empresses, Daoist and Buddhist ritual performances were used.
translations.idiomatic: On the death-days of all emperors and empresses, Daoist and Buddhist ritual performances were used.

sentences.zh: 十八年，增建道院，初本劉光世賜第，後以韓世忠第增築之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, a Daoist abbey was added; originally it had been Liu Guangshi's granted residence, later expanded with Han Shizhong's residence.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, a Daoist abbey was added; originally it had been Liu Guangshi's granted residence, later expanded with Han Shizhong's residence.

sentences.zh: 天興殿九楹，中殿七楹，後殿十有七楹，齋殿、進食殿皆備焉。

translations.literal: The Tianxing Hall had nine bays, the central hall seven bays, the rear hall seventeen bays; fasting halls and food-presenting halls were all provided.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianxing Hall had nine bays, the central hall seven bays, the rear hall seventeen bays; fasting halls and food-presenting halls were all provided.

sentences.zh: 神御殿，古原廟也，以奉安先朝之御容。

translations.literal: The Hall of Spirit Likenesses—the ancient Original Temple—receives installation of former dynasties' imperial likenesses.
translations.idiomatic: The Hall of Spirit Likenesses—the ancient Original Temple—receives installation of former dynasties' imperial likenesses.

sentences.zh: 宣祖、昭憲皇后於資福寺慶基殿。

translations.literal: The Exalted Ancestor and Empress Zhaoxian at Zifu Temple's Qingji Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The Exalted Ancestor and Empress Zhaoxian at Zifu Temple's Qingji Hall.

sentences.zh: 太祖神禦之殿七：太平興國寺開元殿、景靈宮、應天禪院西院、南京鴻慶宮、永安縣會聖宮、揚州建隆寺章武殿、滁州大慶寺端命殿。

translations.literal: The seven halls for Taizu's spirit likeness: Taiping Xingguo Temple's Kaiyuan Hall, Jingling Palace, Yingtian Chan Cloister's western courtyard, Nanjing Hongqing Palace, Yongan County Huisheng Palace, Yangzhou Jianlong Temple's Zhangwu Hall, Chuzhou Daqing Temple's Duanming Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The seven halls for Taizu's spirit likeness: Taiping Xingguo Temple's Kaiyuan Hall, Jingling Palace, Yingtian Chan Cloister's western courtyard, Nanjing Hongqing Palace, Yongan County Huisheng Palace, Yangzhou Jianlong Temple's Zhangwu Hall, Chuzhou Daqing Temple's Duanming Hall.

sentences.zh: 太宗神御之殿七：啟聖禪院、壽寧堂、景福殿、鳳翔上清太平宮、并州崇聖寺統平殿及西院、鴻慶宮、會聖宮。

translations.literal: The seven halls for Taizong's spirit likeness: Qisheng Chan Cloister, Shouning Hall, Jingfu Hall, Fengxiang Shangqing Taiping Palace, Bingzhou Chongsheng Temple's Tongping Hall and western courtyard, Hongqing Palace, Huisheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The seven halls for Taizong's spirit likeness: Qisheng Chan Cloister, Shouning Hall, Jingfu Hall, Fengxiang Shangqing Taiping Palace, Bingzhou Chongsheng Temple's Tongping Hall and western courtyard, Hongqing Palace, Huisheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 真宗神御之殿十有四：景靈宮奉真殿、玉清昭應宮安聖殿、洪福院、壽寧堂、福聖殿、崇先觀永崇殿、萬壽觀延聖殿、澶州信武殿、西京崇福宮保祥殿、華州雲台觀集真殿及西院、鴻慶宮、會聖宮、鳳翔太平宮。

translations.literal: The fourteen halls for Zhenzong's spirit likeness: Jingling Palace's Fengzhen Hall, Yujing Zhaoying Palace's Ansheng Hall, Hongfu Cloister, Shouning Hall, Fusheng Hall, Chongxian Abbey's Yongchong Hall, Wanshou Abbey's Yansheng Hall, Danzhou Xinwu Hall, Xijing Chongfu Palace's Baoxiang Hall, Huazhou Yuntai Abbey's Jizhen Hall and western courtyard, Hongqing Palace, Huisheng Palace, Fengxiang Taiping Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The fourteen halls for Zhenzong's spirit likeness: Jingling Palace's Fengzhen Hall, Yujing Zhaoying Palace's Ansheng Hall, Hongfu Cloister, Shouning Hall, Fusheng Hall, Chongxian Abbey's Yongchong Hall, Wanshou Abbey's Yansheng Hall, Danzhou Xinwu Hall, Xijing Chongfu Palace's Baoxiang Hall, Huazhou Yuntai Abbey's Jizhen Hall and western courtyard, Hongqing Palace, Huisheng Palace, Fengxiang Taiping Palace.

sentences.zh: 仁宗、英宗、神宗、哲宗四朝神御於景靈宮、應天院，章獻明肅皇后於慈孝寺彰德殿，章懿皇后於景靈宮廣孝殿，明德、章穆二後於普安院重徽殿，章惠太后於萬壽觀廣慶殿。

translations.literal: The four reigns of Renzong, Yingzong, Shenzong, and Zhezong at Jingling Palace and Yingtian Cloister; Empress Zhangxian Mingsu at Cixiao Temple's Zhangde Hall; Empress Zhangyi at Jingling Palace's Guangxiao Hall; Empresses Mingde and Zhangmu at Pu'an Cloister's Chonghui Hall; Empress Dowager Zhanghui at Wanshou Abbey's Guangqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The four reigns of Renzong, Yingzong, Shenzong, and Zhezong at Jingling Palace and Yingtian Cloister; Empress Zhangxian Mingsu at Cixiao Temple's Zhangde Hall; Empress Zhangyi at Jingling Palace's Guangxiao Hall; Empresses Mingde and Zhangmu at Pu'an Cloister's Chonghui Hall; Empress Dowager Zhanghui at Wanshou Abbey's Guangqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 景德四年，奉安太祖御容應天禪院，以宰臣向敏中為奉安聖容禮儀使，權安於文德殿。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jingde, Taizu's imperial likeness was installed with reverence at Yingtian Chan Cloister; Chief Minister Xiang Minzhong served as Commissioner for Installing the Sagely Likeness Ritual Protocol, temporarily installed at the Wende Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jingde, Taizu's imperial likeness was installed with reverence at Yingtian Chan Cloister; Chief Minister Xiang Minzhong served as Commissioner for Installing the Sagely Likeness Ritual Protocol, temporarily installed at the Wende Hall.

sentences.zh: 百官班列，帝行酌獻禮，鹵簿導引，升彩輿進發，帝辭於正陽門外，百官辭於瓊林苑門外。

translations.literal: All officials were arrayed; the emperor performed the libation and offering ritual; the guard of honor escorted; the colored carriage advanced in procession; the emperor took leave outside Zhengyang Gate; all officials took leave outside Qionglin Garden Gate.
translations.idiomatic: All officials were arrayed; the emperor performed the libation and offering ritual; the guard of honor escorted; the colored carriage advanced in procession; the emperor took leave outside Zhengyang Gate; all officials took leave outside Qionglin Garden Gate.

sentences.zh: 遣官奏告昌陵畢，群臣稱賀。

translations.literal: Officials were dispatched to memorialize at Chang Mausoleum; when complete, all ministers offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were dispatched to memorialize at Chang Mausoleum; when complete, all ministers offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 皇祐中，以滁州通判王靖請，滁、並、澶三州建殿奉神御，乃宣諭曰：「太祖擒皇甫暉於滁州，是受命之端也，大慶寺殿名曰端命，以奉太祖。

translations.literal: In the Huangyou era, because Chuzhou Vice Commissioner Wang Jing requested it, halls were built at Chu, Bing, and Dan to receive spirit likenesses. An imperial announcement stated: "Taizu captured Huangfu Hui at Chuzhou—this was the beginning of receiving the Mandate; the Daqing Temple hall is named Duanming, to receive Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: In the Huangyou era, because Chuzhou Vice Commissioner Wang Jing requested it, halls were built at Chu, Bing, and Dan to receive spirit likenesses. An imperial announcement stated: "Taizu captured Huangfu Hui at Chuzhou—this was the beginning of receiving the Mandate; the Daqing Temple hall is named Duanming, to receive Taizu.

sentences.zh: 太宗取劉繼元於并州，是太平之統也，即崇聖寺殿名曰統平，以奉太宗。

translations.literal: Taizong took Liu Jiyuan at Bingzhou—this was the succession of Great Peace; therefore the Chongsheng Temple hall is named Tongping, to receive Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong took Liu Jiyuan at Bingzhou—this was the succession of Great Peace; therefore the Chongsheng Temple hall is named Tongping, to receive Taizong.

sentences.zh: 真宗歸契丹於澶州，是偃武之信也，即舊寺殿名曰信武，以奉真宗。」

translations.literal: Zhenzong returned the Khitan at Danzhou—this was the trust of laying down arms; therefore the old temple hall is named Xinwu, to receive Zhenzong."
translations.idiomatic: Zhenzong returned the Khitan at Danzhou—this was the trust of laying down arms; therefore the old temple hall is named Xinwu, to receive Zhenzong.

sentences.zh: 既而統平殿災，諫官範鎮言：「并州素無火災，自建神御殿未幾而輒焚，天意若曰祖宗御容非郡國所宜奉安者。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward the Tongping Hall burned; Remonstrance Official Fan Zhen stated: "Bingzhou has never had fire disasters; scarcely had the spirit likeness hall been built when it burned—the intent of Heaven seems to say that ancestors' imperial likenesses are not what commanderies and states should receive and install.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward the Tongping Hall burned; Remonstrance Official Fan Zhen stated: "Bingzhou has never had fire disasters; scarcely had the spirit likeness hall been built when it burned—the intent of Heaven seems to say that ancestors' imperial likenesses are not what commanderies and states should receive and install.

sentences.zh: 近聞下并州復加崇建，是徒事土木，重困民力，非所以答天意也。

translations.literal: We have heard that Bingzhou is again to be magnificently rebuilt—this is merely piling up earth and timber, again burdening the people's strength, and is not how to answer Heaven's intent.
translations.idiomatic: We have heard that Bingzhou is again to be magnificently rebuilt—this is merely piling up earth and timber, again burdening the people's strength, and is not how to answer Heaven's intent.

sentences.zh: 自并州平七十七年，故城父老不入新城，宜寬其賦輸，緩其徭役，以除其患，使河東之民不忘太宗之德，則陛下孝思，豈特建一神御殿比哉？」

translations.literal: Seventy-seven years have passed since Bingzhou was pacified; the old city's elders still do not enter the new city. It is fitting to lighten their tax deliveries and ease their corvée labor, to remove their afflictions, so that the people of Hedong do not forget Taizong's virtue—then Your Majesty's filial thought, how can it be compared merely to building one spirit likeness hall?"
translations.idiomatic: Seventy-seven years have passed since Bingzhou was pacified; the old city's elders still do not enter the new city. It is fitting to lighten their tax deliveries and ease their corvée labor, to remove their afflictions, so that the people of Hedong do not forget Taizong's virtue—then Your Majesty's filial thought, how can it be compared merely to building one spirit likeness hall?

sentences.zh: 先是，睦親、廣親二宅並建神御殿，翰林學士歐陽修言神御非人臣私家之禮。

translations.literal: Earlier, the two residences of Muxin and Guangqin both built spirit likeness halls; Academician Ouyang Xiu stated that spirit likenesses are not the ritual of a subject's private household.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, the two residences of Muxin and Guangqin both built spirit likeness halls; Academician Ouyang Xiu stated that spirit likenesses are not the ritual of a subject's private household.

sentences.zh: 下兩製、台諫、禮官議，以為「漢用《春秋》之義，罷郡國廟。

translations.literal: The Two Academies, remonstrance officials, and ritual officials were ordered to deliberate, holding that "Han used the meaning of the 《Spring and Autumn Annals》 and abolished commandery and state temples.
translations.idiomatic: The Two Academies, remonstrance officials, and ritual officials were ordered to deliberate, holding that "Han used the meaning of the 《Spring and Autumn Annals》 and abolished commandery and state temples.

sentences.zh: 今睦親宅、廣親宅所建神御殿，不合典禮，宜悉罷。」

translations.literal: Now the spirit likeness halls built at the Muxin and Guangqin residences do not accord with canonical ritual and should all be abolished."
translations.idiomatic: Now the spirit likeness halls built at the Muxin and Guangqin residences do not accord with canonical ritual and should all be abolished.

sentences.zh: 詔以廣親宅置已久，唯罷修睦親宅。

translations.literal: An edict stated that because the Guangqin residence had been established long, only construction at the Muxin residence was halted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated that because the Guangqin residence had been established long, only construction at the Muxin residence was halted.

sentences.zh: 熙寧二年，奉安英宗御容於景靈宮，帝親行酌獻，仍詔歲以十月望朝享，有期以上喪或災異，則命輔臣攝事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xining, Yingzong's imperial likeness was installed with reverence at Jingling Palace; the emperor personally performed libation and offering; an edict also directed that each year on the fifteenth of the tenth month there be court worship; if mourning above the stipulated period or natural disaster occurred, assisting ministers were commanded to officiate.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xining, Yingzong's imperial likeness was installed with reverence at Jingling Palace; the emperor personally performed libation and offering; an edict also directed that each year on the fifteenth of the tenth month there be court worship; if mourning above the stipulated period or natural disaster occurred, assisting ministers were commanded to officiate.

sentences.zh: 知大宗正丞事李德芻言：「禮法：諸侯不得祖天子，公廟不設於私家。

translations.literal: Li Decou, Associate Director of the Imperial Clan Court, stated: "Ritual law: feudal lords may not take the Son of Heaven as ancestor; a duke's temple is not set up in a private household.
translations.idiomatic: Li Decou, Associate Director of the Imperial Clan Court, stated: "Ritual law: feudal lords may not take the Son of Heaven as ancestor; a duke's temple is not set up in a private household.

sentences.zh: 今宗室邸第並有帝後神御，非所以明尊卑崇正統也，望一切廢罷。」

translations.literal: Now the mansions of the imperial clan all have spirit likenesses of emperors and empresses—this is not how to clarify superiority and inferiority and exalt orthodox succession; it is hoped that all be abolished."
translations.idiomatic: Now the mansions of the imperial clan all have spirit likenesses of emperors and empresses—this is not how to clarify superiority and inferiority and exalt orthodox succession; it is hoped that all be abolished.

sentences.zh: 下禮官詳定，請如所奏。

translations.literal: Ritual officials were ordered to deliberate in detail and requested to follow the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials were ordered to deliberate in detail and requested to follow the memorial.

sentences.zh: 詔諸宗室宮院祖宗神御迎藏天章閣。

translations.literal: An edict directed that spirit likenesses of ancestors in the various imperial clan palaces be welcomed and stored in the Tianzhang Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that spirit likenesses of ancestors in the various imperial clan palaces be welcomed and stored in the Tianzhang Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 自是，臣庶之家凡有御容，悉取藏禁中。

translations.literal: From this time, wherever subjects' households had imperial likenesses, all were taken and stored within the forbidden precinct.
translations.idiomatic: From this time, wherever subjects' households had imperial likenesses, all were taken and stored within the forbidden precinct.

sentences.zh: 元豐五年，作景靈宮十一殿，而在京宮觀寺院神御，皆迎入禁中，所存惟萬壽觀延聖、廣愛、寧華三殿而已。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yuanfeng, eleven halls of Jingling Palace were built; spirit likenesses at capital monasteries and temples were all welcomed into the forbidden precinct; those remaining were only the three halls of Wanshou Abbey's Yansheng, Guang'ai, and Ninghua.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Yuanfeng, eleven halls of Jingling Palace were built; spirit likenesses at capital monasteries and temples were all welcomed into the forbidden precinct; those remaining were only the three halls of Wanshou Abbey's Yansheng, Guang'ai, and Ninghua.

sentences.zh: 宣和元年，禮部奏：「太常寺參酌立到諸州府有祖宗御容所在朔日諸節序降至禦封香表及下降香表行禮儀注：

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuanhe, the Ministry of Rites memorialized: "The Court of Imperial Sacrifices has deliberated and established ritual protocol notes for commanderies and prefectures where ancestors' imperial likenesses are located, for the first day of the month and festival days when imperial sealed incense memorials descend and when descending incense memorials are performed:
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuanhe, the Ministry of Rites memorialized: "The Court of Imperial Sacrifices has deliberated and established ritual protocol notes for commanderies and prefectures where ancestors' imperial likenesses are located, for the first day of the month and festival days when imperial sealed incense memorials descend and when descending incense memorials are performed:

sentences.zh: 朔日諸節序奉香表行禮儀注。

translations.literal: Ritual protocol notes for presenting incense memorials on the first day of the month and festival days.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual protocol notes for presenting incense memorials on the first day of the month and festival days.

sentences.zh: 齋戒，朝拜前一日，朝拜官及讀表文官早赴齋所，俟禮備，禮生引讀表文官、齎香表官集朝拜官聽，執事者以香表呈視。

translations.literal: Fasting: on the day before court worship, the worshiping official and the official reading the memorial early proceed to the fasting quarters; when ritual is ready, ritual attendants lead the official reading the memorial and the official bearing the incense memorial to assemble before the worshiping official to hear instructions; attendants present the incense memorial for inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Fasting: on the day before court worship, the worshiping official and the official reading the memorial early proceed to the fasting quarters; when ritual is ready, ritual attendants lead the official reading the memorial and the official bearing the incense memorial to assemble before the worshiping official to hear instructions; attendants present the incense memorial for inspection.

sentences.zh: 禮生請讀表文官稍前習讀表，或密詞即讀封題，訖，禮生讚復位。

translations.literal: Ritual attendants request the official reading the memorial to step forward slightly to practice reading the memorial; if the wording is secret, the sealed title is read; when finished, ritual attendants praise return to position.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual attendants request the official reading the memorial to step forward slightly to practice reading the memorial; if the wording is secret, the sealed title is read; when finished, ritual attendants praise return to position.

sentences.zh: 次以禦封香、禮饌等呈視訖，各復齋所。

translations.literal: Next the imperial sealed incense, ritual provisions, and the like are presented for inspection; each returns to the fasting quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Next the imperial sealed incense, ritual provisions, and the like are presented for inspection; each returns to the fasting quarters.

sentences.zh: 朝拜官用長吏，闕，以次官充，讀表文亦以次官充，執事者以有服色者充。

translations.literal: The worshiping official uses the chief administrator; if vacant, the next official in rank serves; reading the memorial likewise uses the next official in rank; attendants use those with colored service dress.
translations.idiomatic: The worshiping official uses the chief administrator; if vacant, the next official in rank serves; reading the memorial likewise uses the next official in rank; attendants use those with colored service dress.

sentences.zh: 有司設香案、時果、牙盤食神御前，又設奠醪茗之器於香案前之左，置禦封香表案上；

translations.literal: The relevant offices set an incense table, seasonal fruit, and tooth-disk offerings before the spirit likeness; also set vessels for offering libation and tea to the left before the incense table, placing the imperial sealed incense memorial on the table;
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices set an incense table, seasonal fruit, and tooth-disk offerings before the spirit likeness; also set vessels for offering libation and tea to the left before the incense table, placing the imperial sealed incense memorial on the table;

sentences.zh: 設朝拜官位於殿下，西向，讀表文官位於殿之南，北向，陪位官位於其後；

translations.literal: set the worshiping official's position below the hall, facing west; the official reading the memorial south of the hall, facing north; attending officials behind them;
translations.idiomatic: set the worshiping official's position below the hall, facing west; the official reading the memorial south of the hall, facing north; attending officials behind them;

sentences.zh: 設焚表文位於殿庭東，南向。

translations.literal: set the position for burning the memorial east of the hall courtyard, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: set the position for burning the memorial east of the hall courtyard, facing south.

sentences.zh: 朝拜日，質明前，香火官先詣殿下，北向拜訖，升殿，東向侍立。

translations.literal: On the worship day, before dawn, the incense official first proceeds below the hall, bows facing north, ascends the hall, and stands attending facing east.
translations.idiomatic: On the worship day, before dawn, the incense official first proceeds below the hall, bows facing north, ascends the hall, and stands attending facing east.

sentences.zh: 有司陳設訖，禮生先引陪位官入就位，北向，次引讀表文官入就位，次引朝拜官就位，西向立定。

translations.literal: When the relevant offices have finished setting out, ritual attendants first lead attending officials in to take position facing north; next lead the official reading the memorial in to take position; next lead the worshiping official in to take position, standing facing west.
translations.idiomatic: When the relevant offices have finished setting out, ritual attendants first lead attending officials in to take position facing north; next lead the official reading the memorial in to take position; next lead the worshiping official in to take position, standing facing west.

sentences.zh: 禮生讚有司謹具，請行事。

translations.literal: Ritual attendants praise: the relevant offices respectfully prepared—please perform the ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual attendants praise: the relevant offices respectfully prepared—please perform the ritual.

sentences.zh: 禮生讚再拜，拜訖，引讀表文官先升殿，於香案之右東向立，次引朝拜官詣香案前，讚搢笏、上香、奠酒茗，拜、興，少立。

translations.literal: Ritual attendants praise bow twice; when bows are complete, lead the official reading the memorial to ascend the hall first and stand east of the incense table facing east; next lead the worshiping official to the incense table; praise insert tablet, offer incense, present libation and tea, bow, rise, and stand briefly.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual attendants praise bow twice; when bows are complete, lead the official reading the memorial to ascend the hall first and stand east of the incense table facing east; next lead the worshiping official to the incense table; praise insert tablet, offer incense, present libation and tea, bow, rise, and stand briefly.

sentences.zh: 禮生讚搢笏、跪、讀表文，或密詞即讀封題，執笏興，降復位。

translations.literal: Ritual attendants praise insert tablet, kneel, read the memorial—or if secret, read the sealed title—hold tablet, rise, descend and return to position.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual attendants praise insert tablet, kneel, read the memorial—or if secret, read the sealed title—hold tablet, rise, descend and return to position.

sentences.zh: 朝拜官再拜，降復位。

translations.literal: The worshiping official bows again, descends and returns to position.
translations.idiomatic: The worshiping official bows again, descends and returns to position.

sentences.zh: 禮生讚再拜訖，引朝拜官、讀表文官詣焚表文位南向立，焚訖，退。

translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianping of Zhenzong, an edict first directed that Grand Preceptor, posthumously enfeoffed as Director of the Secretariat, Prince of Han Zhao Pu receive associated offering in Taizu's temple courtyard.

sentences.zh: 臣兩蒙宣諭，欲用文武臣各兩人，文臣故宰相贈太師秦國公諡忠穆呂頤浩、特進觀文殿大學士諡忠簡趙鼎，武臣太師蘄王諡忠武韓世忠、太師魯王諡忠烈張俊。

translations.literal: Your servant twice received imperial announcement, wishing to use two civil and two military officials: the civil officials, the former chief minister posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Preceptor, Prince of Qin, posthumous title Zhongmu Lü Yihao, and specially advanced Grandee of the Hall for Observing Literature, posthumous title Zhongjian Zhao Ding; the military officials, Grand Preceptor Prince of Qi, posthumous title Zhongwu Han Shizhong, and Grand Preceptor Prince of Lu, posthumous title Zhonglie Zhang Jun.
translations.idiomatic: He twice received imperial announcement, wishing to use two civil and two military officials: the civil officials, the former chief minister posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Preceptor, Prince of Qin, posthumous title Zhongmu Lü Yihao, and specially advanced Grandee of the Hall for Observing Literature, posthumous title Zhongjian Zhao Ding; the military officials, Grand Preceptor Prince of Qi, posthumous title Zhongwu Han Shizhong, and Grand Preceptor Prince of Lu, posthumous title Zhonglie Zhang Jun.

sentences.zh: 此四人皆一時名將相，合於天下公論。」

translations.literal: These four persons were all famous generals and chief ministers of their time, accordant with public opinion throughout the realm."
translations.idiomatic: These four persons were all famous generals and chief ministers of their time, accordant with public opinion throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 議者皆以為宜，遂從之。

translations.literal: The debaters all held it fitting, and this was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The debaters all held it fitting, and this was followed.

sentences.zh: 秘書少監楊萬里獨謂丞相張浚不得配食為非，爭之不得，因去位焉。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Secretariat Yang Wanli alone held that Chief Minister Zhang Jun not receiving associated sacrifice was wrong; unable to prevail in the dispute, he therefore left his post.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director of the Secretariat Yang Wanli alone held that Chief Minister Zhang Jun not receiving associated sacrifice was wrong; unable to prevail in the dispute, he therefore left his post.

sentences.zh: 紹熙五年十二月，以左丞相、贈太師、魯國公陳康伯配享孝宗廟庭。

translations.literal: In Shaoxi 5, twelfth month, Chen Kangbo, Left Chancellor, posthumously Grand Preceptor and Duke of Lu, was associated in sacrifice in Xiaozong's temple court.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Shaoxi 5, Chen Kangbo, Left Chancellor, posthumous Grand Preceptor, and Duke of Lu, was enshrined for associated sacrifice in Xiaozong's temple court.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙元年正月，以右丞相、贈太師葛邲配享光宗廟庭。

translations.literal: In Jiaxi 1, first month, Ge Bi, Right Chancellor and posthumously Grand Preceptor, was associated in sacrifice in Guangzong's temple court.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Jiaxi 1, Ge Bi, Right Chancellor and posthumous Grand Preceptor, was enshrined for associated sacrifice in Guangzong's temple court.

sentences.zh: 嘉定十四年八月，追封右丞相史浩為越王，改諡忠定，配享孝宗廟庭。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourteenth year of Jiading, Right Chief Minister Shi Hao was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yue, his posthumous title changed to Zhongding, and he received associated sacrifice in Xiaozong's temple courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourteenth year of Jiading, Right Chief Minister Shi Hao was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yue, his posthumous title changed to Zhongding, and he received associated sacrifice in Xiaozong's temple courtyard.

sentences.zh: 端平二年八月，以太師趙汝愚配享寧宗廟庭。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year of Duanping, Grand Preceptor Zhao Ruyu received associated sacrifice in Ningzong's temple courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year of Duanping, Grand Preceptor Zhao Ruyu received associated sacrifice in Ningzong's temple courtyard.

sentences.zh: 初，仁宗天聖中郊祀，詔錄故相李昉、宋琪、呂端、張齊賢、畢士安、王旦，執政李至、王沔、溫仲舒及陳洪進等子孫以官。

translations.literal: Initially, in Renzong's Tiansheng era at suburban sacrifice, an edict recorded the sons and grandsons of the former chief ministers Li Fang, Song Qi, Lü Duan, Zhang Qixian, Bi Shi'an, and Wang Dan, the governing officials Li Zhi, Wang Han, and Wen Zhongshu, and Chen Hongjin and others, granting them offices.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, in Renzong's Tiansheng era at suburban sacrifice, an edict recorded the sons and grandsons of the former chief ministers Li Fang, Song Qi, Lü Duan, Zhang Qixian, Bi Shi'an, and Wang Dan, the governing officials Li Zhi, Wang Han, and Wen Zhongshu, and Chen Hongjin and others, granting them offices.

sentences.zh: 元豐中，詔：景靈宮繪像舊臣推恩本支下兩房以上，取不食祿者，均有無，取齒長者；

translations.literal: In the Yuanfeng era, an edict stated: for old ministers whose likenesses were painted at Jingling Palace, extend grace to two branches and above of the original line, selecting those not receiving salary; if some have it and some do not, take the eldest by age;
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanfeng era, an edict stated: for old ministers whose likenesses were painted at Jingling Palace, extend grace to two branches and above of the original line, selecting those not receiving salary; if some have it and some do not, take the eldest by age;

sentences.zh: 若子孫亦繪像，本房不食祿，更不取別房。

translations.literal: if sons and grandsons are also painted, and this branch does not receive salary, do not take from another branch.
translations.idiomatic: if sons and grandsons are also painted, and this branch does not receive salary, do not take from another branch.

sentences.zh: 紹聖初，林希請稽考慶曆以後未經編次臣僚，其子孫應錄用者以次編定。

translations.literal: In the early Shaosheng era, Lin Xi requested examining officials after Qingli who had not yet been arranged in sequence, whose sons and grandsons should be recorded for employment, and arranging them in order.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Shaosheng era, Lin Xi requested examining officials after Qingli who had not yet been arranged in sequence, whose sons and grandsons should be recorded for employment, and arranging them in order.

sentences.zh: 尋詔：「趙普社稷殊勳，其諸孤有無食祿者，各官其一子，以長幼為序，毋過三人。」

translations.literal: Shortly afterward an edict stated: "Zhao Pu's special merit to the altars of state—among his various orphans, whether or not they receive salary, each grant one son an office, in order of age, not exceeding three persons."
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward an edict stated: "Zhao Pu's special merit to the altars of state—among his various orphans, whether or not they receive salary, each grant one son an office, in order of age, not exceeding three persons.

sentences.zh: 崇寧初，詔：「哲宗繪像文武臣僚，並與子若孫一人初品官，若子孫眾多，無過家一人。」

translations.literal: In the early Chongning era, an edict stated: "For civil and military officials whose likenesses were painted under Zhezong, each grant one son or grandson an initial-rank office; if sons and grandsons are numerous, not exceeding one person per household."
translations.idiomatic: In the early Chongning era, an edict stated: "For civil and military officials whose likenesses were painted under Zhezong, each grant one son or grandson an initial-rank office; if sons and grandsons are numerous, not exceeding one person per household.

sentences.zh: 又錄藝祖功臣呂餘慶族孫偉及司徒富弼孫直柔、直道以官，使奉其祀。

translations.literal: Also recorded Artemisia Ancestor's meritorious minister Lü Yuqing's clansman Wei and Director of Works Fu Bi's grandsons Zhirou and Zhidao for offices, commanding them to perform sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Also recorded Artemisia Ancestor's meritorious minister Lü Yuqing's clansman Wei and Director of Works Fu Bi's grandsons Zhirou and Zhidao for offices, commanding them to perform sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 靖康初，臣僚言：「司馬光之後再絕，復立族子稹，稹亦卒。

translations.literal: In the early Jingkang era, officials stated: "Sima Guang's line was twice extinguished; a clansman Zhen was again established, and Zhen also died.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Jingkang era, officials stated: "Sima Guang's line was twice extinguished; a clansman Zhen was again established, and Zhen also died.

sentences.zh: 今雖有子，而光遺表恩澤已五十年，不可復奏，請許移奏見存曾孫，使之世祿。」

translations.literal: Now although there is a son, Guang's memorial requesting grace has already been fifty years and cannot be submitted again—it is requested that permission be granted to transfer the memorial to the surviving great-grandson, enabling hereditary salary."
translations.idiomatic: Now although there is a son, Guang's memorial requesting grace has already been fifty years and cannot be submitted again—it was requested that permission be granted to transfer the memorial to the surviving great-grandson, enabling hereditary salary.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 群臣家廟，本於周制，適士以上祭於廟，庶士以下祭於寢。

translations.literal: Family temples of officials originate in Zhou institutions: from Appropriate Scholar upward sacrifice at the temple; from Common Scholar downward sacrifice at the sleeping chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Family temples of officials originate in Zhou institutions: from Appropriate Scholar upward sacrifice at the temple; from Common Scholar downward sacrifice at the sleeping chamber.

sentences.zh: 唐原周制，崇尚私廟。

translations.literal: Tang followed Zhou institutions and exalted private temples.
translations.idiomatic: Tang followed Zhou institutions and exalted private temples.

sentences.zh: 五季之亂，禮文大壞，士大夫無襲爵，故不建廟，而四時寓祭室屋。

translations.literal: In the chaos of the Five Dynasties, ritual texts were greatly destroyed; scholar-officials had no inherited enfeoffments, therefore did not build temples, but at the four seasons lodged sacrifice in chamber rooms.
translations.idiomatic: In the chaos of the Five Dynasties, ritual texts were greatly destroyed; scholar-officials had no inherited enfeoffments, therefore did not build temples, but at the four seasons lodged sacrifice in chamber rooms.

sentences.zh: 慶曆元年，南郊赦書，應中外文武官並許依舊式立家廟。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qingli, the southern suburban amnesty edict permitted all civil and military officials within and without the court to establish family temples according to the old form.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qingli, the southern suburban amnesty edict permitted all civil and military officials within and without the court to establish family temples according to the old form.

sentences.zh: 已而宋庠又以為言，乃下兩製、禮官詳定其制度：「官正一品平章事以上立四廟；

translations.literal: Shortly afterward Song Qi again spoke on this; the Two Academies and ritual officials were then ordered to deliberate in detail the institutions: "Officials of the first rank of regular title and chief ministers and above establish four temples;
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward Song Qi again spoke on this; the Two Academies and ritual officials were then ordered to deliberate in detail the institutions: "Officials of the first rank of regular title and chief ministers and above establish four temples;

sentences.zh: 樞密使、知樞密院事、參知政事、樞密副使、同知樞密院事、簽書院事，見任、前任同，宣徽使、尚書、節度使、東宮少保以上，皆立三廟；

translations.literal: Commissioner of Military Affairs, Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Participating Administrator of Affairs, Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs, Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Signatory of the Bureau—whether in current or former office, the same; Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service, Director of the Secretariat, Military Commissioner, Eastern Palace Junior Mentor and above—all establish three temples;
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner of Military Affairs, Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Participating Administrator of Affairs, Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs, Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Signatory of the Bureau—whether in current or former office, the same; Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service, Director of the Secretariat, Military Commissioner, Eastern Palace Junior Mentor and above—all establish three temples;

sentences.zh: 餘官祭於寢。

translations.literal: remaining officials sacrifice at the sleeping chamber.
translations.idiomatic: remaining officials sacrifice at the sleeping chamber.

sentences.zh: 凡得立廟者，許適子襲爵以主祭。

translations.literal: All who may establish temples are permitted to have the legitimate son inherit enfeoffment to preside over sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: All who may establish temples are permitted to have the legitimate son inherit enfeoffment to preside over sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 其襲爵世降一等，死即不得作主祔廟，別祭於寢。

translations.literal: The inherited enfeoffment descends one grade each generation; at death one may not preside as principal enshrinement in the temple, but sacrifices separately at the sleeping chamber.
translations.idiomatic: The inherited enfeoffment descends one grade each generation; at death one may not preside as principal enshrinement in the temple, but sacrifices separately at the sleeping chamber.

sentences.zh: 自當立廟者，即祔其主，其子孫承代，不計廟祭、寢祭，並以世數疏數遷祧；

translations.literal: For those who should establish temples, enshrine their principals; descendants inherit in succession; regardless of temple sacrifice or chamber sacrifice, all remove distant ancestors by generational distance;
translations.idiomatic: For those who should establish temples, enshrine their principals; descendants inherit in succession; regardless of temple sacrifice or chamber sacrifice, all remove distant ancestors by generational distance;

sentences.zh: 始得立廟者不祧，以比始封。

translations.literal: those first permitted to establish temples are not removed, by comparison with first enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: those first permitted to establish temples are not removed, by comparison with first enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 有不祧者，通祭四廟、五廟。

translations.literal: Where there are those not removed, sacrifice universally through four or five temples.
translations.idiomatic: Where there are those not removed, sacrifice universally through four or five temples.

sentences.zh: 廟因眾子立而適長子在，則祭以適長子主之；

translations.literal: When the temple is established because of many sons but the legitimate eldest son is alive, sacrifice is presided over by the legitimate eldest son;
translations.idiomatic: When the temple is established because of many sons but the legitimate eldest son is alive, sacrifice is presided over by the legitimate eldest son;

sentences.zh: 嫡長子死，即不傳其子，而傳立廟者之長。

translations.literal: when the legitimate eldest son dies, the succession is not passed to his son but to the eldest of the temple founder's line.
translations.idiomatic: when the legitimate eldest son dies, the succession is not passed to his son but to the eldest of the temple founder's line.

sentences.zh: 凡立廟，聽於京師或所居州縣。

translations.literal: Whenever establishing a temple, permission is granted in the capital or in one's prefecture or county of residence.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever establishing a temple, permission is granted in the capital or in one's prefecture or county of residence.

sentences.zh: 其在京師者，不得於裏城及南郊御路之側。」

translations.literal: Those in the capital may not be within the inner city or on either side of the southern suburban imperial road."
translations.idiomatic: Those in the capital may not be within the inner city or on either side of the southern suburban imperial road.

sentences.zh: 仍別議襲爵之制，既以有廟者之子孫或官微不可以承祭，而朝遷又難盡推襲爵之恩，事竟不行。

translations.literal: Deliberation on the institution of inheriting enfeoffment was separate; since sons of those with temples might have minor offices and could not undertake sacrifice, and court promotions were hard to extend enfeoffment grace entirely—the matter in the end was not implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Deliberation on the institution of inheriting enfeoffment was separate; since sons of those with temples might have minor offices and could not undertake sacrifice, and court promotions were hard to extend enfeoffment grace entirely—the matter in the end was not implemented.

sentences.zh: 大觀二年，議禮局言：「所有臣庶祭禮，請參酌古今，討論條上，斷自聖衷。」

translations.literal: In the second year of Daguan, the Ritual Deliberation Office stated: "For all subjects' sacrifice rituals, it is requested to consult past and present, discuss articles and present them upward, to be decided by the imperial mind."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daguan, the Ritual Deliberation Office stated: "For all subjects' sacrifice rituals, it is requested to consult past and present, discuss articles and present them upward, to be decided by the imperial mind.

sentences.zh: 於是議禮局議：「執政以上祭四廟，餘通祭三廟。」

translations.literal: Thereupon the Ritual Deliberation Office deliberated: "Governing officials and above sacrifice at four temples; the remainder universally sacrifice at three temples."
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Deliberation Office deliberated: "Governing officials and above sacrifice at four temples; the remainder universally sacrifice at three temples."

sentences.zh: 「古無祭四世者，又侍從官以至士庶，通祭三世，無等差多寡之別，豈禮意乎？

translations.literal: "In antiquity there was no sacrificing to four generations; moreover from attendant officials down to common scholars, all universally sacrificed to three generations, with no distinction of rank, more or less—is this the intent of ritual?
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity there was no sacrificing to four generations; moreover from attendant officials down to common scholars, all universally sacrificed to three generations, with no distinction of rank, more or less—is this the intent of ritual?

sentences.zh: 古者天子七世，今太廟已增為九室，則執政視古諸侯，以事五世，不為過矣。

translations.literal: In antiquity the Son of Heaven reached seven generations; now the Grand Temple has already been increased to nine chambers—then governing officials, compared to ancient feudal lords, sacrificing to five generations is not excessive.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity the Son of Heaven reached seven generations; now the Grand Temple has already been increased to nine chambers—then governing officials, compared to ancient feudal lords, sacrificing to five generations is not excessive.

sentences.zh: 先王制禮，以齊有萬不同之情，賤者不得僭，貴者不得逾。

translations.literal: Former kings made ritual to align the feelings of the myriad different— the low may not usurp, the exalted may not exceed.
translations.idiomatic: Former kings made ritual to align the feelings of the myriad different—the low may not usurp, the exalted may not exceed.

sentences.zh: 故事二世者，雖有孝思追遠之心，無得而越，事五世者，亦當跂以及焉。

translations.literal: Those with two generations, though they have the heart of filial reflection and reaching far, cannot overstep; those with five generations should also strive to reach that far.
translations.idiomatic: Those with two generations, though they have the heart of filial reflection and reaching far, cannot overstep; those with five generations should also strive to reach that far.

sentences.zh: 今恐奪人之恩，而使通祭三世，徇流俗之情，非先王制禮等差之義。

translations.literal: Now I fear seizing others' grace and making universal sacrifice to three generations, indulging popular sentiment—is not the meaning of former kings' ritual distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: Now I fear seizing others' grace and making universal sacrifice to three generations, indulging popular sentiment—is not the meaning of former kings' ritual distinctions.

sentences.zh: 可文臣執政官、武臣節度使以上祭五世，文武升朝官祭三世，餘祭二世。」

translations.literal: It is fitting that civil governing officials and military officials of Military Commissioner rank and above sacrifice to five generations; civil and military officials promoted to court sacrifice to three generations; the remainder sacrifice to two generations."
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting that civil governing officials and military officials of Military Commissioner rank and above sacrifice to five generations; civil and military officials promoted to court sacrifice to three generations; the remainder sacrifice to two generations."

sentences.zh: 「應有私第者，立廟於門內之左，如狹隘，聽於私第之側。

translations.literal: "Those with private residences should establish temples to the left within the gate; if cramped, permission is granted beside the private residence.
translations.idiomatic: Those with private residences should establish temples to the left within the gate; if cramped, permission is granted beside the private residence.

sentences.zh: 力所不及，仍許隨宜。」

translations.literal: Where strength does not reach, permission is still granted according to circumstances."
translations.idiomatic: Where strength does not reach, permission is still granted according to circumstances.

sentences.zh: 又詔：「古者寢不逾廟，禮之廢失久矣。

translations.literal: Another edict stated: "In antiquity the sleeping chamber did not exceed the temple—this ritual has long been lost.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "In antiquity the sleeping chamber did not exceed the temple—this ritual has long been lost.

sentences.zh: 士庶堂寢，逾度僭禮，有七楹、九楹者，若一旦使就五世、三世之數，則當徹毀居宇，以應禮制，豈得為易行？

translations.literal: Common scholars' hall chambers and sleeping chambers exceed measure and usurp ritual, some with seven or nine bays—if suddenly made to conform to five or three generations, then dwellings must be demolished to answer ritual institutions; how can this be easy to implement?
translations.idiomatic: Common scholars' hall chambers and sleeping chambers exceed measure and usurp ritual, some with seven or nine bays—if suddenly made to conform to five or three generations, then dwellings must be demolished to answer ritual institutions; how can this be easy to implement?

sentences.zh: 可自今立廟，其間數視所祭世數，寢間數不得逾廟。

translations.literal: From now on when establishing temples, the number of bays should match the generations sacrificed to; the number of sleeping-chamber bays may not exceed the temple.
translations.idiomatic: From now on when establishing temples, the number of bays should match the generations sacrificed to; the number of sleeping-chamber bays may not exceed the temple.

sentences.zh: 事二世者，寢聽用二間。」

translations.literal: Those sacrificing to two generations are permitted two bays for the sleeping chamber."
translations.idiomatic: Those sacrificing to two generations are permitted two bays for the sleeping chamber.

sentences.zh: 議禮局言：「《禮記·王制》：『諸侯五廟，二昭二穆，與太祖之廟而五。』

translations.literal: The Ritual Deliberation Office stated: "The 《Record of Rites · Royal Regulations》: 'Feudal lords have five temples, two zhao and two mu, with the temple of the founding ancestor making five.
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Deliberation Office stated: "The 《Record of Rites · Royal Regulations》: 'Feudal lords have five temples, two zhao and two mu, with the temple of the founding ancestor making five.

sentences.zh: 所謂『太』者，蓋始封之祖，不必五世，又非臣下所可通稱。

translations.literal: What is called "Grand" is the ancestor of first enfeoffment—not necessarily five generations, and again not what subjects may universally address.
translations.idiomatic: What is called "Grand" is the ancestor of first enfeoffment—not necessarily five generations, and again not what subjects may universally address.

sentences.zh: 今高祖以上一祖未有名稱，欲乞稱五世祖。

translations.literal: Now one ancestor above Gaozu has no designation—it is requested that he be called the fifth-generation ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Now one ancestor above Gaozu has no designation—it was requested that he be called the fifth-generation ancestor.

sentences.zh: 其家廟祭器：正一品，每室籩、豆各十有二，簠、簋各四，壺尊、罍、鉶鼎、俎、篚各二，尊、罍加勺、冪各一，爵各一，諸室共用胙俎、罍洗一。

translations.literal: Sacrificial vessels for family temples: for the first rank of regular title, each chamber has twelve baskets and stands each, four grain vessels and meat vessels each, two wine jars, libation vessels, offering cauldrons, offering stands, and baskets each, wine jars with ladles and covers one each, libation cups one each; all chambers share one meat stand and libation wash.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial vessels for family temples: for the first rank of regular title, each chamber has twelve baskets and stands each, four grain vessels and meat vessels each, two wine jars, libation vessels, offering cauldrons, offering stands, and baskets each, wine jars with ladles and covers one each, libation cups one each; all chambers share one meat stand and libation wash.

sentences.zh: 從一品籩、豆、簠、簋降殺以兩。

translations.literal: From the first rank, baskets, stands, grain vessels, and meat vessels are reduced by two.
translations.idiomatic: From the first rank, baskets, stands, grain vessels, and meat vessels are reduced by two.

sentences.zh: 正二品籩、豆各八，簠、簋各二。

translations.literal: For the second rank of regular title, eight baskets and stands each, two grain vessels and meat vessels each.
translations.idiomatic: For the second rank of regular title, eight baskets and stands each, two grain vessels and meat vessels each.

sentences.zh: 餘皆如正一品之數。」

translations.literal: The remainder are all as for the first rank of regular title."
translations.idiomatic: The remainder are all as for the first rank of regular title.'

sentences.zh: 詔禮制局製造，仍取旨以給賜之。

translations.literal: An edict directed the Ritual Standards Office to manufacture them, still taking imperial decision for bestowal.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed the Ritual Standards Office to manufacture them, still taking imperial decision for bestowal.

sentences.zh: 紹興十六年二月癸丑，詔太師、左僕射、魏國公秦檜合建家廟，命臨安守臣營之。

translations.literal: On the day guichou of the second month of the sixteenth year of Shaoxing, an edict directed that Grand Preceptor, Vice Director of the Left Secretariat, and Prince of Wei Qin Hui jointly establish a family temple, commanding the Lin'an defending official to build it.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou of the second month of the sixteenth year of Shaoxing, an edict directed that Grand Preceptor, Vice Director of the Left Secretariat, and Prince of Wei Qin Hui jointly establish a family temple, commanding the Lin'an defending official to build it.

sentences.zh: 太常請建於其私第中門之左，一常五室，五世祖居中，東二昭，西二穆。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices requested building to the left of the middle gate of his private residence—one regular hall and five chambers; the fifth-generation ancestor in the center, two zhao to the east, two mu to the west.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices requested building to the left of the middle gate of his private residence—one regular hall and five chambers; the fifth-generation ancestor in the center, two zhao to the east, two mu to the west.

sentences.zh: 堂飾以黝堊。

translations.literal: The hall was decorated with dark plaster.
translations.idiomatic: The hall was decorated with dark plaster.

sentences.zh: 神板長一尺，博四寸五分，厚五寸八分，大書某官某大夫之神坐，貯以帛囊，藏以漆函。

translations.literal: Spirit boards were one foot long, four inches five fen wide, five inches eight fen thick, inscribed in large characters with a certain official, a certain grandee's spirit seat, stored in silk bags and kept in lacquered cases.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit boards were one foot long, four inches five fen wide, five inches eight fen thick, inscribed in large characters with a certain official, a certain grandee's spirit seat, stored in silk bags and kept in lacquered cases.

sentences.zh: 歲四享用孟月柔日行之，具三獻。

translations.literal: Four seasonal offerings each year were performed on the soft day of the meng month, with three presentations.
translations.idiomatic: Four seasonal offerings each year were performed on the soft day of the meng month, with three presentations.

sentences.zh: 有司言時享用常器常饌，帝仿政和故事，命製祭器賜之。

translations.literal: The relevant offices stated that seasonal offerings used ordinary vessels and ordinary provisions; the emperor, following the Zhenghe precedent, commanded sacrificial vessels to be made and bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices stated that seasonal offerings used ordinary vessels and ordinary provisions; the emperor, following the Zhenghe precedent, commanded sacrificial vessels to be made and bestowed.

sentences.zh: 其後，太傅昭慶節度平樂郡王韋淵、太尉保慶節度吳益、少傅寧遠節度楊存中並請建家廟，賜以祭器。

translations.literal: Afterward, Grand Tutor Prince of Pingle Commandery of Zhaoging Military Commission Wei Yuan, Grand Commandant Military Commission of Baoging Wu Yi, and Junior Tutor Military Commission of Ningyuan Yang Cunzhong all requested family temples established and were bestowed sacrificial vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, Grand Tutor Prince of Pingle Commandery of Zhaoging Military Commission Wei Yuan, Grand Commandant Military Commission of Baoging Wu Yi, and Junior Tutor Military Commission of Ningyuan Yang Cunzhong all requested family temples established and were bestowed sacrificial vessels.

sentences.zh: 隆興二年四月庚辰，少師、四川宣撫使吳璘請用存中例，從之。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen of the fourth month of the second year of Longxing, Junior Mentor and Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Wu Lin requested using Cunzhong's precedent; this was followed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen of the fourth month of the second year of Longxing, Junior Mentor and Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Wu Lin requested using Cunzhong's precedent; this was followed.

sentences.zh: 乾道八年九月，詔有司賜少保、武安節度、四川宣撫使虞允文家廟祭器如故事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the eighth year of Qiandao, an edict directed the relevant offices to bestow family temple sacrificial vessels on Junior Mentor, Military Commission of Wu'an, and Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Yu Yunwen according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the eighth year of Qiandao, an edict directed the relevant offices to bestow family temple sacrificial vessels on Junior Mentor, Military Commission of Wu'an, and Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Yu Yunwen according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 淳熙五年七月，戶部尚書韓彥古請以賜第進父世忠家廟如存中。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year of Chunxi, Minister of Revenue Han Yangu requested presenting his father Shizhong's family temple using the granted residence, following Cunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year of Chunxi, Minister of Revenue Han Yangu requested presenting his father Shizhong's family temple using the granted residence, following Cunzhong.

sentences.zh: 十二月，少傅、保寧節度衛國公史浩請建家廟，量賜祭器。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Junior Tutor, Military Commission of Baoning, and Prince of Wei Guo Shi Hao requested a family temple established and sacrificial vessels bestowed in measured amount.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Junior Tutor, Military Commission of Baoning, and Prince of Wei Guo Shi Hao requested a family temple established and sacrificial vessels bestowed in measured amount.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰元年，太傅、永興節度、平原郡王韓侂胄奏：「曾祖琦效忠先朝，奕世侑食，家廟猶闕，請下禮官考其制建之。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiatai, Grand Tutor, Military Commission of Yongxing, and Prince of Pingyuan Commandery Han Tuozhou memorialized: "My great-grandfather Qi loyally served the former court; for generations our family has received associated sacrifice, yet the family temple is still lacking—it is requested that ritual officials examine the institutions and build it."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiatai, Grand Tutor, Military Commission of Yongxing, and Prince of Pingyuan Commandery Han Tuozhou memorialized: "My great-grandfather Qi loyally served the former court; for generations our family has received associated sacrifice, yet the family temple is still lacking—it is requested that ritual officials examine the institutions and build it.

sentences.zh: 二年，循忠烈王張俊，開禧三年，鄜武僖王劉光世子孫相繼有請，皆從之。

translations.literal: In the second year, Loyal and Martyr Prince Zhang Jun; in the third year of Kaixi, Martial and Worthy Prince Liu Guangshi's sons and grandsons made requests in succession—all were followed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Loyal and Martyr Prince Zhang Jun; in the third year of Kaixi, Martial and Worthy Prince Liu Guangshi's sons and grandsons made requests in succession—all were followed.

sentences.zh: 嘉定十四年八月，詔右丞相史彌遠賜第，遵淳熙故事賜家廟，命臨安守臣營之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourteenth year of Jiading, an edict granted a residence to Right Chief Minister Shi Miyuan, following the Chunxi precedent bestowing a family temple, commanding the Lin'an defending official to build it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourteenth year of Jiading, an edict granted a residence to Right Chief Minister Shi Miyuan, following the Chunxi precedent bestowing a family temple, commanding the Lin'an defending official to build it.

sentences.zh: 禮官討論祭器，並如侂胄之制。

translations.literal: Ritual officials deliberated sacrificial vessels, all following Tuozhou's regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials deliberated sacrificial vessels, all following Tuozhou's regulations.

sentences.zh: 彌遠請並生母齊國夫人周氏及祔妻魯國夫人潘氏於生母別廟，皆下有司賜器。

translations.literal: Miyuan requested enshrining together his birth mother Lady Zhou of Qi State and his enshrined wife Lady Pan of Lu State in the birth mother's separate temple—all were ordered to the relevant offices for bestowal of vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Miyuan requested enshrining together his birth mother Lady Zhou of Qi State and his enshrined wife Lady Pan of Lu State in the birth mother's separate temple—all were ordered to the relevant offices for bestowal of vessels.

sentences.zh: 景定三年，詔丞相賈似道賜家廟，命臨安守、漕營度，禮官討論賜祭器，並如儀。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingding, an edict granted Chief Minister Jia Sidao a family temple, commanding the Lin'an defender and transport commissioner to plan and build; ritual officials deliberated bestowing sacrificial vessels, all according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jingding, an edict granted Chief Minister Jia Sidao a family temple, commanding the Lin'an defender and transport commissioner to plan and build; ritual officials deliberated bestowing sacrificial vessels, all according to ritual.
